title: ELITE VIDEO EDITOR WANTED — LONG-TERM PARTNERSHIP
description:
Let me be upfront with you, because that's how we operate.



We're a D2C e-commerce brand in the women's health space. We sell a product that genuinely helps people, and every piece of content we produce reflects that. No misleading claims. No bait-and-switch.



We're into a 5-year vision. We're scaling aggressively in the English-speaking market, and we need editors who grow with us, not editors who disappear when a bigger project comes along, and not a company that goes quiet after 3 months because the brand didn't work out.



We're in this for the long game. We want you to be too.



- THE ROLE:



Position: Direct Response VSL Video Editor (Health/Pain Relief Specialist)

Commitment: Full-time, long-term (this is not a freelance gig)

Compensation: $1,000-$1,250 monthly + performance bonuses

Location: 100% remote

Hours: 40h/week

Market: English-speaking



- WHAT LONG-TERM ACTUALLY MEANS HERE:



- Year-over-year salary increases of 10–20% for strong performers

- Performance bonuses tied directly to VSL and ad conversion rates

- Creative ownership, you won't be executing someone else's vision blindly. You'll understand the strategy, the avatar, the psychology behind every piece of content

- A real team, you'll work closely with the founder and marketing lead, not get lost in a ticket queue



- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



Non-negotiable:



- 2+ years editing Direct Response VSLs ads (health/women's wellness a strong plus)

- Proven retention, you understand why a cut happens at second 4, not just how to make it

- Proficiency in CapCut

- Experience with AI video tools (Higgsfield, Veo, etc.)



Strong preference:



- You've edited ads that actually ran and converted

- You understand
/Instagram ad formats and platform behavior

- You've worked with health or wellness brands and know the compliance landscape



- WHO THRIVES HERE:



You care about the work beyond the deliverable. You watch your edited videos after they go live and wonder how to make the next one better. You understand that a 3-second hook isn't decoration, it's the difference between a winning creative and a dead one.



You want to be part of something being built, not just service it.



- WHO THIS IS NOT FOR:



If you're looking to freelance across 6 clients simultaneously, this isn't the right fit. We want someone who is genuinely invested in one brand's growth, because that's where the real upside is.



- THE PROCESS:



We review every application carefully. Portfolio quality matters far more than volume. If your work is strong and your approach is right, you'll hear from us within a week.



We move fast, but we don't rush the decision on people.

description:
Remote Receptionist & Intake Coordinator

U.S. Immigration Law Firm | Full-Time Remote Position | Philippines

The Law Offices of Fogam & Associates, LLC, a U.S.-based immigration law firm, is seeking an exceptional Remote Receptionist & Intake Coordinator based in the Philippines.

This is a front-line client-service position. You will often be the first person prospective and existing clients speak with. We therefore require excellent spoken and written English, strong listening skills, sound judgment, professionalism, warmth, accuracy, and exceptional reliability.

This is not simply a call-answering position. The successful candidate must follow detailed scripts and procedures, listen carefully, obtain and record important information, distinguish between types of calls, identify potentially urgent matters, assist with preliminary intake and qualification, and communicate information promptly and accurately to our U.S. office.

Primary Responsibilities

• Answer incoming calls promptly, warmly, and professionally.

• Follow firm-approved telephone, intake, client-service, qualification, and follow-up scripts.

• Listen carefully and ask appropriate scripted follow-up questions.

• Accurately document the caller's identity, contact information, reason for calling, important dates/deadlines, requested action, and appropriate next step.

• Conduct preliminary intake and qualification of prospective clients using firm procedures. Do not provide legal advice.

• Identify promising or time-sensitive prospective-client inquiries and promptly transmit them to the Office Administrator or Operations Manager.

• Coordinate or schedule appointments with the Office Administrator or Operations Manager when authorized by firm procedures.

• Do not schedule appointments directly with Attorney Fogam and do not represent that you have access to his calendar.

• Follow up with prospective clients according to established procedures and scripts.

• Route existing-client calls and messages to the appropriate team member.

• Recognize potentially urgent situations and immediately escalate them according to the firm's escalation protocol.

• Prepare clear, concise written summaries of calls and communications.

• Send routine call/activity digests approximately every two hours to the Office Administrator.

• Send urgent matters immediately; do not wait for the next two-hour report.

• Send qualified or high-priority prospective-client opportunities promptly after the call.

• Prepare a detailed end-of-day report accounting for calls, inquiries, follow-ups, unresolved matters, and required next actions.

• Maintain strict confidentiality concerning all client and firm information.

Communication & Escalation

Receptionist → Office Administrator → Operations Manager → Attorney

Routine matters should be handled or routed without unnecessarily involving the attorney. Potential emergencies must be escalated immediately. The receptionist should not bypass the chain of responsibility except where a firm procedure specifically requires it.

Required Qualifications

• Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation and strong listening comprehension.

title: Freight Dispatcher — U.S. Trucking (Experience Required, Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
About us

WH Trucking is a U.S.-based asset carrier operating out of Georgia. We run dedicated contract freight, intermodal/rail moves, and spot loads. We are a small team that moves fast, and you will work directly with the owner.



We are hiring four dispatchers to build out 24/7 coverage. This is a long-term position with room to grow as we add trucks.



A note on the schedule: our night shift runs 6:00 PM – 6:00 AM U.S. Eastern, which is approximately 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM Philippine time. If you are assigned nights, you will be working normal daytime hours locally.



What you'll do

Coordinate daily load assignments and driver schedules

Communicate with drivers throughout your shift on pickups, deliveries, and delays

Manage a dedicated contract account with recurring weekly loads

Handle rail/intermodal pickups and in-gate coordination

Track loads from pickup through delivery; flag problems before they escalate

Collect and file BOLs, PODs, and rate confirmations

Maintain dispatch trackers and operational spreadsheets

Escalate facility, appointment, and detention issues

Support spot load bidding and rate research

Hand off cleanly to the incoming dispatcher at shift change



Required

Prior U.S. freight dispatching experience. This is not negotiable. In your application, name the carriers or brokerages you dispatched for and the fleet size.

Strong written and spoken English — you will speak with U.S. drivers and facility staff every shift

Confident on the phone, including with frustrated drivers

Proficient in Google Workspace (Sheets, Gmail, Drive, Docs)

Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection, and a plan for power outages

Quiet, dedicated workspace

Self-starter who solves problems rather than forwarding them



Nice to have — we will train

Amazon Relay experience

Intermodal / rail experience (CSX, BNSF)

Any TMS experience

FMCSA compliance familiarity

Small-fleet dispatch experience (as opposed to large carrier)



Availability requirements

This is a 12-hour shift position on a rotating schedule averaging 42 hours per week, with every other weekend off.



Dispatch is a live-coverage role. Trucks, drivers, and facilities do not wait, and no one else can cover your desk while you are away from it. This position requires:



Full availability for your entire 12-hour shift, without interruption

A dedicated workspace separate from household activity

Reliable internet plus a backup connection and a power outage plan

No other concurrent job or client work during your shift

Consistent attendance — coverage gaps directly affect our customer accounts

Willingness to work either day or night rotation as assigned



Please be honest with yourself about this before applying. If your current situation does not allow you to be at your desk and responsive for a full 12-hour block, this role will not be a good fit, and we would rather you apply for something that suits your schedule better.



HOW TO APPLY 

To apply, complete BOTH steps. Applications missing either step will not be reviewed.



Step 1 — Send your resume and answer in your own words: Which carriers or brokerages have you dispatched for, and how many trucks?



Step 2 — Record a Loom video (3 minutes maximum).



Record yourself as if you are on the phone with one of our drivers. He has arrived at a rail facility to pick up a load. The kiosk says there is no waybill for his load, so he cannot get in the gate. He has been waiting 40 minutes and he is frustrated.



Talk through how you would handle that call and what you would do next.



Do not script it. We want to hear how you actually think.



Include your Loom link with your application.

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

Partnership revenue, two lanes:

D. Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep-tier package: 25% of upgrade fees for the first 90 days after go-live, then 10% through month 12, plus the bond bonus ladder (+$500 at $10K minted, +$1,000 at $20K, +$5,000 at $100K and every $100K after, cumulative, no ceiling).

E. Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn an override equal to 20% of your rep's commission payouts, paid by GMI on top of their commission, never deducted from them, plus $250 per partnership once $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain).

Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.

F, Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

G. No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

H. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

I. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start 





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: Performance Video Editor & Creative Strategist — AI-Driven DTC Health Ads ($1,000/mo+)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

 

We are a fast-growing DTC health supplement brand (Revalia — Ethiopian black seed oil, primarily targeting arthritis with many other angles in testing) running direct response video ads on Meta to adults 50+ in the United States. We are hiring a full-time Performance Video Editor & Creative Strategist who can own an ad end to end — concept, script, and edit — not just cut footage together.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE IS:

 

You are not editing vlogs, YouTube videos, or social media content. You are creating direct response video ads that run on cold traffic at real ad spend. Every frame, every transition, every piece of b-roll, every voiceover cut exists for one reason: to keep a skeptical 60-year-old watching long enough to click. If the ad doesn't perform, it gets killed. The creative is the difference between an ad that scales and an ad that dies in testing.

 

This role is not for someone who needs to be handed a script and told what to do. You come up with the concept, write the script, and build the ad yourself. If you have only edited brand content, social media reels, or YouTube videos — or you can only execute other people's ideas — this role is not for you.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

 

You will own the full creative pipeline: concept → script → edit → deliver. One person, full production. On every ad you are making the creative decisions:

 

- Coming up with the concept and angle. You study the brand, the audience, and the mechanism, and you generate ad ideas that will actually convert to cold traffic.

- Writing the script yourself. Most ads run 30-60 seconds, but longer formats (up to 3-5 minutes) get made too when the angle calls for it — you use your judgment based on what's working. Hook, body, CTA. You know how a fear-based ad, a discovery ad, a doctor ad, and a personal-story ad each need to be written differently.

- Choosing and generating the right b-roll for every section. Not just "find a clip that matches the words." You d
 what visual makes the viewer FEEL something at that exact moment.

- Pacing the hook so the first 3 seconds stop the scroll. The hook isn't just the first line — it's the first visual, the first sound, the first text on screen, and the speed at which all three hit at once.

- Casting the voiceover tone to match the script's intent, selecting music that supports the emotion without competing with the voiceover, designing captions that feel native to the platform, and building transitions the viewer moves through without noticing.

 

You are not editing. You are building ads from a blank page.

 

AI IS NOT OPTIONAL:

 

We use AI tools heavily and daily. This is not a traditional role where you sit in Premiere for 8 hours cutting footage someone else shot. You are generating AI UGC, AI voiceovers, AI b-roll, AI animations, and combining them with real footage to create ads that look and feel authentic.

 

Tools we use include:

- Higgsfield for AI video generation, character animation, and b-roll creation

- ElevenLabs for AI voiceovers and voice cloning

- Runway for motion and visual generation

- CapCut or Premiere for editing

- Canva for thumbnails and static elements

 

If you are not already using AI tools like these in your daily workflow, this role is not for you. We are not looking for someone "willing to learn AI." We need someone who already generates AI assets as part of how they work.

 

WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT:

 

Most editing jobs hand you footage and say "make it look good." Even most "editor" ad jobs hand you a script and say "make it convert." This role is different — you write the script AND make it convert. You are thinking about performance at every step:

- Why does this hook need to hit in under 2 seconds?

- Why does the b-roll need to shift at the mechanism section?

- Why does the pacing slow down when the product is introduced?

- Why does the CTA need urgency without feeling desperate?

 

If you already think like this — as a strategist and an editor at the same time — you will thrive here.

 

WHAT YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE:

 

- Direct response experience — ads that ran on cold traffic for e-commerce, DTC, or supplement brands. Not brand content. Not reels.

- The ability to write your own scripts. This is non-negotiable. You will not be handed scripts. You research the angle, write the hook and body, and build the ad from it.

- AI-native workflow — you already use Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Runway or equivalents daily.

- Hook psychology — you understand what makes the first 3 seconds stop the scroll and can explain why.

- Performance awareness — you know what hook rate, hold rate, CTR, and ROAS mean, and can look at metrics and identify what to change in the next ad.

- Health or supplement niche experience preferred — ads for older, health-conscious buyers. You understand this audience responds differently than a 25-year-old buying a gadget.

- Strong creative instincts — from a blank page, you know what angle to take, what to write, what b-roll to use, what voice to cast, and how to make it feel like content, not a commercial.

 

THIS ROLE IS NOT:

YouTube editing, brand/social content, podcast editing, motion graphics/logo animation, a pure execution role where you wait for scripts, or a junior learn-on-the-job position.

 

If your portfolio is YouTube videos, weddings, vlogs, or brand content — or you can only edit what someone else writes — please do not apply.

 

COMPENSATION AND DETAILS:

- Starting at $1,000 USD per month with performance-based increases as your ads prove out

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, fully remote

- Flexible schedule with daily output expected and end-of-day check-ins via WhatsApp

- Long-term position for someone who wants to own the full creative pipeline

 

HOW TO APPLY:

 

Apply only through this Google Form:

title: Real Estate Executive Assistant / Virtual Assistant
description:
Real Estate Executive Assistant / Virtual Assistant



Part-Time to Start: 20 Hours/Week

$4–$5 USD/Hour Depending on Experience

Opportunity to Grow to 40 Hours/Week + Raises & Bonuses

Long-Term Position | Philippines-Based

U.S. Real Estate Business – Honolulu, Hawaii



About the Position



I am an experienced real estate broker in Honolulu, Hawaii looking for a highly organized, proactive, and dependable Virtual Assistant to become a long-term member of my real estate business.



This position will start at approximately 20 hours per week while we learn how to work together, develop systems, and determine where you can provide the most value.



I am not looking for a temporary freelancer.



My goal is to find the right person who wants to grow with my business for years. As you demonstrate your abilities and the business grows, my goal is to increase this position toward 40 hours per week, increase your hourly compensation, and develop additional performance and/or transaction-based bonuses.



There may also be opportunities for additional training, equipment, software, bonuses, and other benefits as our relationship and the business grow.



I want to invest in the right person.



Who I’m Looking For



You do NOT need to be an expert in everything listed below.



I care more about finding the right person with the right attitude, personality, work ethic, and ability to learn.



I’m looking for someone who is:



* Extremely organized and detail-oriented

* Reliable and consistent

* Proactive and able to work independently

* Comfortable making reasonable decisions based on established processes

* Good at prioritizing based on deadlines and importance

* Comfortable with repetitive and tedious tasks

* Someone who actually enjoys checklists, organization, spreadsheets, CRM cleanup, and completing unfinished tasks

* A problem solver who tries to find solutions

* Comfortable learning new technology

* A strong written and verbal English communicator

* Persistent about following things through to completion

* Able to identify when something is being forgotten

* Comfortable reminding and holding me accountable when necessary

* Interested in learning and taking on greater responsibility over time



I move quickly and frequently have multiple clients, leads, listings, transactions, and projects happening simultaneously.



I need someone who can eventually become my right-hand person and help make sure nothing important falls through the cracks.



If I tell you that I need to call someone and haven’t done it, remind me.



If a transaction deadline is approaching, recognize it and make sure we address it.



If a lead hasn’t been followed up with, bring it to my attention.



If something is unfinished, keep track of it until it’s completed.



Eventually, I want you to be able to tell me:



“Here are the things that need your personal attention today. I’ve already handled everything else.”



Primary Responsibilities



CRM & Lead Management



* Manage and organize Follow Up Boss CRM

* Enter and update contacts

* Clean up duplicate and incomplete records

* Tag and categorize leads and clients

* Maintain accurate notes, stages, tasks, and follow-up dates

* Identify leads that need follow-up

* Create daily follow-up lists for me

* Track outstanding conversations and next steps

* Help make sure leads don’t get forgotten

* Assist with database nurture and reactivation campaigns

* Help organize prospecting and call lists



, Calendar & Organization



* Help manage and organize my

* Identify important
s requiring my attention

* Draft routine
s and responses

* Maintain follow-up reminders

* Manage appointments and scheduling

* Help manage my calendar

* Maintain daily and weekly priority/task lists

* Follow up on unfinished tasks

* Keep track of people we are waiting to hear from

* Help keep me focused on high-priority activities



Transaction Coordination



* Maintain transaction timelines and checklists

* Track contract dates and deadlines

* Organize transaction documents

* Help process sales paperwork

* Assist with preparing offers, addenda, and other real estate documents for my review

* Coordinate with clients, escrow/title, lenders, inspectors, agents, photographers, and vendors

* Follow up on outstanding documents and tasks

* Maintain organized electronic transaction files

* Assist with closing and post-closing processes

* Make sure transaction requirements and deadlines don’t get missed



All activities must remain within applicable real estate licensing requirements. Anything requiring a licensed real estate professional will be handled or approved by me.



Listing Coordination



* Input and update real estate listings

* Organize listing paperwork and disclosures

* Coordinate photography, video, staging, inspections, and other vendors

* Organize listing photos and marketing materials

* Help prepare property descriptions

* Track showing activity and feedback

* Assist with seller updates

* Send routine follow-ups on my behalf

* Schedule appointments and showings

* Communicate with vendors and business partners

* Request reviews and testimonials

* Help maintain contact with past clients

* Make sure clients receive timely responses

* Draft
s and text messages for my approval when needed



Excellent written and spoken English is important.



Social Media & Marketing



Help create, edit, schedule, and manage content for:



*

* Instagram

* LinkedIn

* TikTok

* Google Business Profile

* YouTube/short-form video as we grow



Content may include:



* New listings

* Open houses

* Sold/closed properties

* Client testimonials

* Real estate information

* Market updates

* Educational content

* Community/local Hawaii content

* Videos/Reels

Responsibilities may include:



* Canva graphics

* Basic photo editing

* Video/Reels editing

* Writing captions

* Scheduling posts

* Repurposing content across platforms

* Organizing content calendars

* Tracking basic engagement and results



AI & Technology



I use technology extensively and want someone who is comfortable learning and using AI.



Tools may include:



* Follow Up Boss

*

Experience with some of these is preferred.



You do not need to know everything.



What matters more is that you’re comfortable learning new systems and can figure things out.



Future Areas You Can Grow Into



As you become comfortable with the core responsibilities, there will be opportunities to learn and take ownership of:



* Creating and maintaining SOPs

* Google Business Profile optimization

* Local SEO

* Website/blog content

* AI search optimization

*
 marketing

* Database marketing

*
/Meta Ads

* Marketing analytics

* Business reporting

* Client retention programs

* Past-client/referral campaigns

* Additional business systems and automation



I am happy to provide training and invest in developing the right person.



Growth & Compensation



Starting compensation: $4–$5 USD/hour depending on experience and skill level.



We will initially start at approximately 20 hours per week.



This is intentionally a part-time starting position while we learn how to work together and build the role.



My goal for the right person is to eventually grow this into a 40-hour-per-week, long-term position.



As you demonstrate reliability, learn the business, take ownership, and create more value, there will be opportunities for:



* Increased hours

* Increased hourly compensation

* Performance bonuses

* Transaction/closing bonuses

* Additional paid training

* Equipment or technology support

* Increased responsibilities

* Career advancement as the business grows



The exact bonus and compensation structure will evolve based on your role and contribution to the business.



I want our incentives aligned.



If you help me become more organized, serve more clients, close more transactions, and grow the business, I want you to have the opportunity to grow professionally and financially with me.



Schedule



We will start at approximately 20 hours per week.



Because my business is located in Honolulu, Hawaii, some overlap with Hawaii business hours will be important for communication, client follow-up, and time-sensitive real estate matters.



Other responsibilities can be completed independently.



Please tell me:



* Your preferred working hours

* Your availability

* Whether you currently work for other clients

* Whether you would eventually be interested in working 40 hours/week if the position grows



Requirements



* Excellent written English

* Strong spoken English

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Reliable computer

* Quiet and professional workspace

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent organization and time management

* Ability to meet deadlines

* Comfortable working independently

* Willingness to learn

* Professional and dependable



Previous U.S. real estate experience is highly preferred but not necessarily required for an exceptional candidate who learns quickly and has the right skills and personality.



How to Apply



Please start your application with:



ALOHA CHAD



Applications that don’t include this will not be considered. I want to know that you read the entire job description.



Please include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Why this particular position interests you.

3. Your experience supporting U.S. real estate professionals, if any.

4. Your experience with transaction coordination and real estate paperwork.

5. Your experience with Follow Up Boss or other CRMs.

6. The software and AI tools you know.

7. Your experience with social media, Canva, photo/video editing, SEO, or digital marketing.

8. Your desired starting hourly rate.

9. Your available hours per week.

10. Your preferred working schedule.

11. Whether you would eventually want to move into a 40-hour/week position.

12. Your DISC assessment results, if you have them.



Please also include a 1–2 minute video introduction.



Tell me:



* Who you are

* Your relevant experience

* What you’re particularly good at

* Why you think you would be a good long-term fit for this position



Finally, answer this scenario:



You start your workday and discover that I have 8 leads needing follow-up, a transaction deadline tomorrow, 15 unread client
s, a social media post scheduled for today that isn’t finished, and 500 CRM contacts that need cleanup. How would you prioritize these tasks and why?



There isn’t necessarily one perfect answer. I’m interested in understanding how you think, prioritize, communicate, and solve problems.



Long-Term Opportunity



I am looking for more than someone who completes tasks.



I’m looking for someone who wants to learn my business, understand how I work, help build better systems, and gradually take ownership of important parts of the operation.



We may start at 20 hours per week, but my goal is to find someone who can eventually become a full-time, trusted member of my business for years to come.



If you’re organized, proactive, dependable, enjoy getting things completed, and want an opportunity where your responsibilities and compensation can grow with the business, I would like to hear from you.

title: Accountant
description:

We believe in the power of accurate numbers and, more importantly, in using those numbers to understand the business, solve problems and drive growth in real time. Our team don't just balance books or help companies stay compliant for the ATO. We are all advisors for our clients and offer solutions, insights and support to our clients that goes beyond reconciliation.



We are growing quickly and will need a qualified accountant to join our team. The hours will be in line with Australian Eastern Standard Time. This is a full time permanent position.



You will work 100% remote and need to have fast internet connection and your own device already.



We are seeking someone who has Australian experience already. The day to day responsibilities will include



Working knowledge of client accounting systems (Xero, MYOB, etc.)



Liaise with statutory authorities (ATO, ASIC)



Reconcile ATO accounts with client records



Resolve queries directly with clients



Prepare provision for income tax (non-complex)



Prepare & finalise BAS/IAS independently



Prepare tax returns (individuals, partnerships, trusts, companies, FBT)



Prepare management accounts (monthly/quarterly) with analysis



Prepare special purpose financial accounts & assist with general purpose accounts



Early-stage direct client involvement



Identify client service improvements/add-value opportunities



Prepare budgets & post journals; review management reports



Present accounts/technical matters internally



Independently manage AP, AR, and payroll



Reconcile all general ledger accounts (P&L and balance sheet)



Perform payroll tax & workers’ comp reconciliations



Bookkeeping & clean-ups (with direction)



Monitor chargeability KPIs and feedback to manager



Identify & report new sales opportunities



Update client org charts & processes



You will develop direct relationships with our clients. All of our clients work with a client relationship manager in Sydney who is a Senior Accountant / CFO level person and this role would be to work alongside our team of CRM's.



Your salary will include HMO, as well as 20 annual leave days and 10 sick leave days per year. We have internal Academy program we run which allows people who are interested in upskilling and working towards more senior roles a guided pathway for development.



If you would like to work somewhere that is flexible and focused on teaching their team to deliver advice and practical interpretation of numbers ( not just basic reconciliation) then this opportunity is the right next move for you.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume as an attachment along with your application, highlighting your experience in Australian Accounting. We look forward to hearing from you and learning more about what you could bring to our team.

title: Video Editor & Content Designer (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
Video Editor & Content Designer (Full-Time, Long-Term)



SALARY: $1000 USD / month

Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, Philippine time

Start: within 2 to 4 weeks



ABOUT US



The 30 Hour Coach is an online mentorship for online fitness coaches. We take coaches doing $5k to $30k a month, working far too many hours, and get them to $50k months and beyond.



Our organic content has one job: give real value, build trust, and build a connection with the coaches who watch it. It is not hype for the sake of hype, and it is not "hustle harder" motivation. The voice is Australian, direct and warm. Tactical, real direction on social media for online coaches.



We already have a brand design system built: fonts, colours, templates, rules. You will report to our Operations Manager, who directs all of our content, and check in with her every week. She d
 what gets made. You make it well.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Every week:

- Edit 5 short-form videos from footage the Founder films (30 to 60 seconds, 9:16, burned-in captions, b-roll)

- Design 2 Instagram carousels with a native Instagram feel, from the Operations Manager's direction

- Cut 1 hype reel from footage we record across the week



(Subject to Content Volume Demand)



Ongoing, all directed by the Operations Manager:

- Clip our delivery calls into short-form. Ops tells you what to clip. You make it land

- Clip our YouTube videos into short-form

- Edit our delivery lessons, from workshop Zoom recordings or purpose-filmed footage, into clean lesson videos for our members

- Thumbnails and cover frames

- Keep our drives, footage and b-roll library organised so anyone can find anything (currently using 
)



You are not expected to come up with the content. You are expected to execute it well, fast, and to the brief, every week, without being chased.



YOU MUST HAVE



- At least 1 year editing short-form vertical video for a brand, agency or creator

- DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro

- Photoshop, Figma and Canva for design work

- A portfolio of vertical video you personally cut, plus at least one carousel or static design

- Strong written and spoken English. You will be on a weekly call with the Founder and Operations Manager

- Reliable internet, 25 Mbps or better, and a plan for power outages

- Your own machine that can handle 4K editing, and your own software



NICE TO HAVE



- After Effects or Resolve Fusion for motion

- Fitness, health or coaching content experience

- Experience clipping long recordings (podcasts, webinars, calls) into shorts

- Experience editing lesson or course video



WHAT WE OFFER



- $1000 USD per month, paid via Wise. Twice monthly is preferred, but we are flexible if you need a different split

- 13th month pay

- A long-term role. We want someone for years, not for a project

- One brand, one design system, one person to report to. No juggling five clients with five different styles



HOW TO APPLY



Read this part carefully. Applications that skip these steps get deleted without a reply.



1. Start your message with the word ORANGE.



2. Send 3 links to vertical short-form videos you personally edited, plus 1 carousel or static design you made. For each video, tell me in a single sentence what you were trying to make the viewer feel in the first 2 seconds.



3. Tell me what software you use.



4. Tell me how many hours a week you are currently committed to other clients.



5. Answer this question: a client sends you a 90 second talking-head recording and asks for a 45 second short. What do you cut first, and why?



Do not send a generic cover letter. I read every application that follows these five steps, and I ignore every one that does not.



Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Social Media Content Creator (Reels + Graphics) for Health & Wellness Brands
description:
Hi, my name is James. I'm a Doctor of Osteopathy based in Melbourne, Australia, and I run two businesses I'd love your help with. I'm looking for someone to create social media content for both. I would really appreciate some help with creating consistent, high-quality educational and product content (reels, static posts, carousels, short-form video) across Instagram,
, and TikTok for two related brands in the health and pain-relief space.



Business 1: Bond Osteopathy

Bond Osteopathy is my osteopathy clinic. I treat people for musculoskeletal issues - back pain, neck pain, joint and muscle complaints, posture, mobility, and injury recovery.

What I want to post:

* Educational content about the human body, common musculoskeletal problems, and how osteopathy helps

* Reels demonstrating stretches, mobility drills, posture tips, and "why does X hurt" explainers. I will record the videos and then you can edit them for me.

* Static posts and carousels breaking down anatomy, conditions, and self-care advice in plain language

* Content that builds trust and positions me as a knowledgeable, approachable practitioner and drives local patient bookings

Tone: professional but warm and accessible — no jargon that scares people off. 

Business 2: Knotty Body





Knotty Body is a practitioner-formulated massage cream brand I founded. It's sold direct to consumers online (Shopify) and to allied health clinics. Because I'm an osteopath, the brand's whole positioning is "formulated by a hands-on practitioner who actually treats pain" — real credibility, not generic wellness fluff.

What I want to post:

* Product education — what the cream is, how and when to use it, who it's for

* Reels and short video showing the product in use (application demos, massage routines, pairing with stretches)

* Static posts and carousels

* Lifestyle and brand-building content that makes the product feel premium and trustworthy

* Content that drives online sales and supports clinic/wholesale interest

Tone: clean, premium, credible — health-led, not gimmicky.



What I'm looking for in you

* Proven social media content creation (reels + static)

* Strong short-form video editing

* Reliable, consistent output and good communication

* Bonus: experience with health, wellness, fitness, or e-commerce brands

* Bonus: Canva and basic graphic design 

Ways of working

* I'll provide raw footage, product info, and direction; you turn it into finished, on-brand content

* Open to a content calendar/batching workflow

* Two distinct brands, so you'll need to switch between an educational clinical voice (Bond) and a premium product voice (Knotty Body)



To apply: Please start your reply with the word "KNOTTY" so I know you've read this properly, and include 2–3 links to reels you personally edited. Let me know your availability and your rate. Looking forward to seeing your work!



Thanks for your time



- James

title: Tax Filer
description:
We are seeking Tax Filers to join a growing sales and use tax compliance team. This role owns the execution end of the monthly compliance cycle — preparing and transmitting returns across multiple jurisdictions, reconciling payments, and resolving jurisdictional notices through to closure. It is a deadline-driven, detail-intensive position where accuracy and a complete audit trail matter more than speed alone.



The ideal candidate is someone who works comfortably against a high-volume filing calendar, knows when to stop and escalate rather than guess, and takes pride in clean documentation. Experience filing multistate sales and use tax returns through EDI and jurisdiction portals will set you apart. Two openings are available on this team.



Job Responsibilities:



Receive and review approved filing packages, confirming that required approvals, funding, credentials, and supporting documentation are complete before proceeding.

Prepare, enter, upload, and transmit sales and use tax returns through EDI, online portals, key entry, checks, mail, and other required channels.

Complete online balance reviews and process approved voucher and filing adjustments.

Retain filing confirmations, submission evidence, and supporting documentation for every return transmitted.

Escalate discrepancies or missing information ahead of deadlines without independently altering approved source data, tax positions, or client scope.

Return incomplete filing packages upstream with a specific exception noted and a clear deadline for resolution.

Process or coordinate jurisdiction payments in line with approved controls and funding instructions.

Reconcile filed liabilities, payment confirmations, online balances, and the check register.

Research uncleared, rejected, duplicate, or misapplied payments and coordinate corrective action through to resolution.

Log, receive, and research jurisdictional notices across both mail and online channels.

Review account history and jurisdiction records, prepare notice responses, and submit approved correspondence.

Track notice matters through to full resolution and maintain accurate status records.

Escalate notices involving client decisions, material exposure, taxability positions, or broader account risk to the appropriate stakeholders.

Follow documented filing, payment, credential, evidence retention, and escalation controls without deviation.

Provide timely status updates and exception reporting to the engagement lead and manager.

Identify recurring filing, payment, portal, and notice issues and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Manage a high-volume deadline calendar aligned to jurisdictional due dates throughout each monthly cycle.



Qualifications:



At least 5 years of experience in indirect tax, compliance, accounting operations, or a similar deadline-driven function.

Prior experience supporting US-based clients or US tax operations.

Working knowledge of multistate sales and use tax filing processes and jurisdictional requirements.

Hands-on experience with tax compliance software, jurisdiction portals, EDI transmission, and multiple payment methods.

Intermediate or stronger Excel skills, with strong reconciliation and data entry accuracy.

Proven ability to manage a high-volume deadline calendar with exceptional accuracy and follow-through.

Strong documentation discipline and the ability to preserve a complete audit trail.

Sound escalation judgment — knows when to stop, flag, and seek approval rather than proceed on assumption.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with internal teams and taxing jurisdictions.

Strong organizational and time management skills across competing monthly deadlines.

Bachelor's degree in accounting, business, finance, or a related field preferred.

Experience with check register and payment reconciliation preferred.

Familiarity with jurisdictional notice research and response preparation preferred.

Updated Resume/CV.

title: Partner Network Lead – Philippines
description:
ABOUT US



Bees Mobile is a digital communications service providing virtual

phone numbers (US / HK) and travel eSIM data.



Our customers are people like your friends and family:

· VAs and freelancers who need a US number so international

  clients take them seriously

· OFWs who need to keep an active number for OTP and bank messages

· Travelers who want internet the moment they land



The service is live and selling. Growth comes through a partner

program: people who share the service with their network and

earn from the customers and partners they bring in.



Bees Mobile is now opening the Philippine market and hiring a

small founding team to build the partner network from zero.



─────────────────────────────



THE ROLE



You will build the Bees Mobile partner network in the

Philippines. Not one customer at a time — you find people who can

build teams, bring them in, train them, and help them grow.



If you have built a direct-selling or network-marketing

organization before, you already know this job. If you have led

a large team of agents, resellers, or freelancers and know how to

keep them active, you know most of it.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

· Recruit partners across the Philippines — both experienced

  team leaders (direct-selling leaders, insurance unit managers,

  reseller and agent network heads) and motivated newcomers who

  want to start

· Run online presentations (Zoom / Messenger / FB Live) to

  explain the service and partner program — materials provided

· Onboard and train new partners using the handbook, videos,

  and scripts

· Keep partners active: regular check-ins, answer questions,

  solve problems

· Monitor what partners post and make sure it follows the

  communication standards

· Work with the marketing team on local campaigns: you tell them

  what works in the Philippines and what doesn't

· Track your numbers and send a weekly report to head office



─────────────────────────────



HOW THE TRIAL WORKS



A small founding team starts on a 3-month paid trial with clear,

written targets. Strong performers convert to permanent roles

with a higher base salary. You will get honest feedback on how

you are doing, and the same is expected from you.



─────────────────────────────



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



REQUIRED

· 5+ years recruiting, building, or leading teams, including a

  team of 10 or more that you personally recruited and trained

· Experience in direct selling, network marketing, insurance

  agency, reseller networks, or similar — you understand how

  organizations are built, not just managed

· Excellent written and spoken English; fluent Tagalog

· Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in

  your daily work

· Strong, stable internet and a quiet place to make calls and

  run online presentations

· Organized: you keep records, you follow up, nothing slips

· Self-managed: nobody will be watching over your shoulder,

  and results are still expected

· Honest and direct — you report bad news early



NICE TO HAVE

· You have personally built a downline or organization of

  100+ people

· Experience with
 / Messenger-based recruiting

· An existing network in VA, OFW, or travel communities

· Bisaya or other regional languages



─────────────────────────────



WHAT WE OFFER

· Full-time, long-term position after the trial — not a project

· USD 600 – 1,000/month trial base, up to USD 1,300 base after

  conversion, plus performance bonus with written targets

· Training materials, presentation decks, and scripts provided —

  you spend your time on people, not paperwork



─────────────────────────────



HOW TO APPLY



Applications without the video will not be reviewed.



Send us:

1. Your CV or OnlineJobs profile link

2. A 3-MINUTE VIDEO INTRODUCTION IN ENGLISH, answering:

   a. The largest team or organization you personally built —

      how many people, how long it took, and how you did it

   b. One difficult situation with a team member — what happened

      and how you handled it

   c. If you had to bring in 20 team leaders in your first

      90 days, where would you find them and what would you

      say to them

   d. Why this role interests you

   A phone recording is fine. What you say matters, not

   production quality.

3. Start your message with the word "BEES" so we know you read

   this post completely.



Every applicant who follows these instructions will get a reply.



Bees Mobile Hiring Team

title: US Client Success Specialist – $2,000/month Base + Uncapped Commissions (USD)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Weekend Virtual Assistant – Lead Generation & Appointment Setter
description:
We are looking for a confident, personable and experienced Virtual Assistant / Appointment Setter to join our team on weekends.

This isn't just about sending DMs or following a script.

Your role is to connect with people genuinely.

Every new lead, comment, follow and interaction is an opportunity to start a real conversation, build trust and understand where that person is at.

Your goal is to build authentic relationships across our social platforms, identify and qualify people who may be a great fit for our coaching and ultimately get qualified leads booked onto a call.

What you'll be doing

-Starting genuine conversations with new and existing leads across our social platforms

-Engaging with comments, followers and people interacting with our content

-Following up and nurturing existing leads

-Qualifying potential coaching clients through conversation

-Booking qualified leads onto sales calls

-Following up with people who have previously shown interest but haven't taken the next step

-Keeping lead tracking and CRM information organised and up to date

-Following our lead generation systems and processes while still making conversations feel natural and human

-Communicating with the team around leads, bookings and opportunities



Who we're looking for

This role would suit someone looking to add a few additional weekend hours alongside their current role.

Ideally, you'll have:

-Previous experience in lead generation, qualifying warm/hot leads and booking sales calls

-Experience within the fitness or online coaching industry is highly preferred

-Strong written communication skills

-The ability to understand someone's tone and match their language and communication style

-Confidence deviating from a script when needed rather than sending robotic, copy-and-paste responses

-An understanding of women's weight loss, fitness and the common struggles women face would be a big advantage

-The ability to recognise when someone is genuinely interested and confidently move the conversation towards a call

-Strong organisation and attention to detail

-A warm, energetic personality that aligns with our brand



Hours & earning potential

-The role will initially be approximately 4 hours per day across Saturday and Sunday.

-There is potential for additional hours as the role develops, along with the opportunity to earn commission based on sales generated from calls you have booked.

-We're looking for someone who wants to grow with the role rather than simply tick off a few hours each weekend.



How to apply

Please send through your application outlining your relevant experience, particularly any previous experience with lead generation, appointment setting, sales or the fitness industry.

"I'm ready to Roar"



Applications without this title will not be considered.

title: E-commerce Growth & Content Manager - Fashion Brand
description:
We are a growing modest fashion e-commerce brand looking for an experienced, creative and highly proactive E-commerce, Website & Social Media Growth Manager to work closely with the founder and take ownership of our digital growth.



We are currently a small/start-up brand in a growth and development stage and are looking for someone who wants to become an important long-term member of the business.



This is not a traditional Virtual Assistant role.



We are not looking for someone who simply waits to be given a list of tasks each day. We want someone who can understand our brand and customers, identify opportunities, bring ideas to the table, make recommendations and then execute them.

Your overall objective will be to help us increase brand awareness, grow our social-media presence, improve our website, drive qualified traffic and ultimately increase online sales.



The Role



You will take ownership of key areas of our online presence, including social media, content, our Shopify website, SEO,
 marketing and influencer outreach.

Social Media & Content

You will take an active role in developing our Instagram and TikTok strategy and identifying content opportunities that can help grow the brand.

We want someone who actively follows social-media trends and understands how to adapt them creatively for a fashion/e-commerce brand.

For example, rather than waiting for the founder to decide what to post, we want you to be able to say:

"This style of content is performing well right now. Here's how I think we should adapt it for the brand. Please film these 5–6 clips and send me the raw footage."

The founder can batch-film raw content based on your direction. You will then take it from there - editing, developing the hook, adding on-screen text, creating covers/graphics, writing captions and calls-to-action, scheduling/publishing and monitoring performance.

You will also create professional Canva graphics, carousels, Stories, infographics, promotional content and other digital marketing materials.

The aim is for you to lead the content process, rather than wait for the founder to continuously provide ideas.

Website, Shopify & Conversion

You will also take an active role in developing and improving our Shopify e-commerce website.

We want someone who regularly reviews the website from both a customer and commercial perspective and proactively identifies improvements.



This may include:

Improving the overall look and presentation of the website

Improving product and collection pages

Improving navigation and the customer journey

Product merchandising and presentation

Reviewing product descriptions and website copy

Improving mobile shopping experience

Identifying friction in the purchasing journey

Recommending and implementing conversion improvements

Creating landing pages or promotional pages when required

Keeping the website looking professional, current and consistent with the brand

Using analytics and customer behaviour to identify opportunities for improvement

The goal is not simply to maintain the website. We want you to help make it easier to discover, easier to shop and better at converting visitors into customers.

SEO & Organic Growth

You will work on improving our organic search visibility over time.



Responsibilities may include:



Keyword and competitor research

On-page SEO

Optimising product and collection pages

Improving page titles, meta descriptions and website copy

Identifying search opportunities relevant to our products

Developing SEO-friendly content where appropriate

Monitoring organic performance

Identifying technical or content-related SEO issues

Making ongoing recommendations to increase organic traffic

You do not necessarily need to be an advanced technical SEO specialist, but you should have practical e-commerce SEO experience and understand how to improve the organic visibility of a Shopify store.




 Marketing & Customer Retention

You will help develop our
-marketing strategy rather than only sending occasional promotional
s.

This may include:

Planning
 campaigns

Creating branded
 designs

Writing engaging
 copy

Product and promotional campaigns

Customer-retention
s

Developing and improving automated
 flows

Monitoring open rates, click-throughs, conversions and sales

Testing and improving campaigns based on performance

Influencer & UGC Growth

You will identify suitable influencers, micro-influencers and UGC creators who align with the brand and our target customer.

You will help:

Research potential creators

Manage outreach

Identify collaboration and gifting opportunities

Develop campaign ideas

Maintain relationships with creators

Track collaborations and results

Identify opportunities to repurpose UGC across our social media, website and advertising



Who We're Looking For



We are looking for someone with proven hands-on experience, rather than someone hoping to learn these skills for the first time.

Ideally, you will have previously worked with an e-commerce, fashion, beauty, lifestyle or female-focused consumer brand and can demonstrate the impact of your work.

You should have strong experience with:

Instagram and TikTok

Social-media growth and content strategy

Short-form video editing using CapCut or similar

Canva and visual content creation

Shopify

E-commerce website optimisation

Conversion optimisation

SEO and keyword research


 marketing

Influencer/UGC outreach

Analytics and performance reporting

Excellent written and spoken English is essential.



You should also have a strong visual eye and understand how to maintain a professional and consistent brand aesthetic.

Most importantly, you must be proactive, creative, organised and commercially minded.

We don't want to provide you with a detailed task list every morning.

We want someone who can look at our social media, website, competitors and performance and say:

"I've identified an opportunity. Here's what I recommend we do, why I think it could work and what I need from you to execute it."

We want someone who is comfortable bringing ideas to the founder, rather than waiting for the founder to bring every idea to them.



Working Arrangement & Salary



This is a full-time, remote and long-term position.

You will work closely with the founder but will be expected to manage your workload independently and take ownership of your areas of responsibility.

We are currently a small/start-up brand, so we're looking for someone who understands the realities of working with a growing business and is genuinely excited about helping build something.

Salary is negotiable and will depend on your experience, skills and proven results.

We are working with a start-up budget at this stage, so please include your expected monthly salary for full-time work when applying.

For the right person, there is significant opportunity for the role, responsibilities and compensation to grow alongside the business.



How to Apply

Please include the following with your application:

CV/resume and portfolio.

Links to social-media accounts, e-commerce stores or websites you have personally worked on.

An explanation of exactly what you were responsible for on those projects.

Examples of measurable results you achieved - such as follower growth, reach, engagement, website traffic, SEO improvements, conversion improvements or sales.

Examples of content, Reels/TikToks, Canva designs, websites or
 campaigns you have created.

Details of your experience with Instagram, TikTok, Shopify, Canva, video editing, SEO and
 marketing.

Your expected monthly salary for a full-time position.



Your availability and preferred working hours/time zone.



A short explanation of why you believe you would be suitable for a growing modest-fashion e-commerce brand.



IMPORTANT: Begin your application with the words “ECOM GROWTH” so we know you have read the full job description.

Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will receive further information about the brand and will be invited to an interview.



Final candidates may also be asked to complete a small paid practical assessment before an offer is made.

We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of a growing business - someone who can bring ideas, take ownership, execute and help us achieve measurable growth over the long term.

title: Outbound Sales Lead — LinkedIn & Instagram (B2B, US Agencies)
description:
We are a US video post-production studio. We cut video for marketing agencies who put their own name on the work. We're hiring one person to own outbound.



This is not a script-reading job. I'm not going to hand you a list and a template. I'm going to tell you what we sell and who it's for, and you're going to figure out the rest — who to target, what to say, what's working, what to kill.



$1,400 per month (paid weekly) + Sales Commission



What you own:

• Defining and refining our ICP. We have a starting hypothesis (US marketing, social, and creative agencies, 10–50 people, already selling video). Your job is to sharpen it with real data from real replies.

• Building the prospect list yourself — Sales Navigator, Apollo, agency directories, job boards.

• Writing and testing your own outreach. I'll give you the raw material — our story, our proof, our positioning. You write the messages.

• 40–60 personalized touches a day across LinkedIn and Instagram, from your own profile as part of our team.

• Logging every send: channel, message version, prospect, outcome. Including every ignore and every no. The failures are data and I want them tracked as carefully as the wins.

• Qualifying. You hand me a prospect only when they've answered a real question about their video workflow. A polite "not right now" is not a handoff.

• Reporting weekly: sends by channel and variant, reply rate, qualified handoffs, and what you're changing next week and why.



You'll do well here if you:

• Have 2+ years B2B outbound and can show me real numbers from it.

• Write native-level English. Every message you send is a sample of our creative work — that's the product. This is the hardest requirement and most applicants won't pass it.

• Prefer being told the goal over being told the steps.

• Are disciplined about tracking. If logging your own misses sounds tedious, don't apply.

• Can work 9am–5pm US Eastern (negotiable)



Tools: Sales Navigator, Apollo, Smartlead or similar. A CRM is a plus.



To apply — do not send a generic cover letter. Send:



Who you think our best-fit customer is and why. One paragraph. Disagree with my hypothesis if you think it's wrong.



The first three sentences of a LinkedIn DM you'd send the owner of a 12-person social media agency, offering white-label video editing.



Your real outbound numbers from a past role — sends, reply rate, meetings booked.



Put BULLDOG at the top.
