description:
Hunted is a
 bot for fashion resellers. It watches secondhand marketplaces and pings the reseller the moment a listing matches their brand, size and max price. We are early and growing our customer base through direct outreach.



THE WORK

Cold outreach to fashion resellers, by direct message. WhatsApp, Instagram DM, marketplace chat and
. You send a short, proven three-message sequence, follow up, answer simple questions, and hand warm replies to us. Around 4 hours a day, 5 days a week.



THE ROLE

You receive the lead lists, the message templates, the proof screenshots and a clear script. You deliver conversations: sent openers, follow-ups on schedule, replies handled within the hour during your shift, and a clean log of every lead's status.



You will not write the pitch, design the product or do customer support. We own the copy. You own the volume and the follow-through.



THE BAR

Discipline over cleverness. The messages are short and plain on purpose, and they work. The job is sending them consistently, to the right people, following up without being pushy, and keeping the tracker accurate. If you improvise long pitches, this is not the role.



REQUIRED

- No experience needed. We provide full sales training, step by step. You will understand everything before you send your first message.

- Extremely hungry for money. The bonus is where the real earnings are, and it only pays if you push.

- Disciplined. You show up every day, send the volume, do the follow-ups on time, and keep the tracker accurate without being chased.

- Written English that reads natural in a DM.

- Comfortable sending 100+ messages a day.

- A computer, a phone, and reliable internet.

- Available 4 hours a day on weekdays, overlapping with European working hours.



NICE TO HAVE

Interest in fashion, sneakers or reselling. Any sales, chat support or outreach experience. A second European language.



PAY

- Base: $125 USD / 2 weeks ($250 USD / month) for 20 hours a week.

- Generous bonus on top of base, tied to results, not to messages sent. Full structure is presented when the contract is signed.



This is a long-term role. We are hiring 2 people and keeping the ones who fit.



PROCESS

Two steps.

1. Fill out the form. Two written answers, five minutes.

2. If we like your answers, a short interview on Google Meet.

Training starts the week you are hired.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply here, and only here: hunted.bot/careers/outreach



Applications sent as a reply on this platform are not read. The form is the application.



The form asks two things that d
 everything:

- Why you want this, and what you would do with the bonus money.

- One cold message you would send to a fashion reseller, in your own words, under 60 words.



Write both yourself. We can tell when it is copied or AI-generated, and we skip those.



No CV, no cover letter, no portfolio. We read every application and reply to all of them, either way. Expect an answer within 3 days.

title: ### Lead Generation • Cold Calling • Appointment Setting • Business Development
description:
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Remote

**Industry:** Staffing & Business Services



## About the Role



We are looking for an experienced **Cold Calling & Sales Representative** to help us generate new business and build a consistent pipeline of qualified prospects.



Our company provides **staffing solutions and business services**, including helping businesses that may need staffing, recruiting, websites, and other services.



Your primary responsibility will be to **identify potential businesses, contact decision-makers, qualify their needs, generate interest, and book sales appointments.**



This is a **sales and business development position**, not a basic administrative VA role.



## Key Responsibilities



* Research and identify businesses that may need our services

* Find and build lists of qualified prospects

* Make outbound cold calls to business owners and decision-makers

* Send targeted cold
s and other outreach

* Follow up consistently with prospects

* Qualify prospects and identify their business needs

* Book qualified appointments and sales meetings

* Maintain accurate CRM and lead records

* Track conversations, follow-ups, and opportunities

* Follow up with warm leads

* Help improve our sales and prospecting process

* Assist with closing sales when appropriate



## Required Qualifications



* **Proven experience in cold calling and outbound sales**

* Experience with **lead generation and appointment setting**

* Strong spoken and written English

* Comfortable speaking directly with business owners and decision-makers

* Strong follow-up and organizational skills

* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

* Able to handle rejection and continue prospecting

* Self-motivated and able to work independently

* Comfortable using CRM systems and learning new sales tools



## Preferred Experience



The following are strong advantages:



* Previous experience **personally closing sales**

* B2B sales experience

* Experience selling staffing or recruiting services

* Experience selling websites, digital marketing, or other business services

* Experience with CRM systems

* Experience with
 outreach or sales campaigns

* Experience using AI tools for sales, prospect research, lead generation, or outreach



## AI & Technology



We are looking for someone who understands how to use modern technology to make sales and prospecting more efficient.



Experience using **ChatGPT or other AI tools** for:



* Prospect research

* Finding potential clients

* Personalizing cold
s

* Creating sales messaging

* Lead qualification

* Organizing prospect information

* Improving sales workflows



is a major advantage.



You should be comfortable learning new tools and finding ways to improve productivity.



## The Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who:



✔ Is confident speaking with business owners

✔ Has a genuine sales mindset

✔ Knows how to generate opportunities instead of waiting for leads

✔ Understands the importance of consistent follow-up

✔ Is comfortable with rejection

✔ Can identify a business problem and connect it to a solution

✔ Takes initiative

✔ Is organized and results-oriented

✔ Uses AI and technology intelligently

✔ Wants to grow with a company long-term



## Important



**This is NOT a basic VA or data-entry position.**



We are looking for someone with real experience in **cold calling, lead generation, appointment setting, and preferably closing sales.**



If your experience is primarily administrative work or customer service without outbound sales experience, this position will not be a good fit.



## How To Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application:



**1. How many years of cold calling / outbound sales experience do you have?**



**2. Approximately how many cold calls did you make per day in your previous position?**



**3. What have you personally sold in the past? Please explain what you were selling and whether you were responsible for closing the sale.**



**4. What AI tools have you actually used for sales, lead generation, prospect research, or outreach?**



**5. What CRM, dialing,
 outreach, or lead-generation tools have you used?**



**6. Give us one example of a sale you personally closed that started as a cold lead.**



Please provide specific examples whenever possible. Generic answers such as “I am hardworking, motivated, and a fast learner” will not help us evaluate your application.



We are looking for a **results-oriented sales professional** who can take ownership of prospecting and help build a strong pipeline of new business.



### KEY SKILLS



**Cold Calling | B2B Sales | Lead Generation | Appointment Setting | Sales Closing |
 Outreach | AI Tools**

title: AI E-commerce Video Editor for AliExpress Products
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled AI Video Editor who can independently create high-converting video ads for AliExpress products.



This is not a basic video editing position where we provide the script, footage, and complete concept.



You will often receive only an AliExpress product link. From there, you should be able to research the product, understand the customer, find strong selling angles and hooks, source or generate the necessary content, and create the complete video ad from beginning to end.



What You Will Do



-Research AliExpress products, competitors, customer pain points, benefits, reviews, and existing ads



-Find strong hooks, selling angles, emotional triggers, and video concepts



-Write or improve scripts for short-form ecommerce ads



-Find existing product footage, UGC, demonstrations, reviews, competitor content, and other useful content online



-Use AI tools to generate missing footage when suitable existing content cannot be found



-Create realistic AI product demonstrations, lifestyle scenes, UGC-style content, actors, voiceovers, and other visuals



-Make sure AI-generated footage accurately represents the real product



-Edit complete ads with strong hooks, pacing, captions, pattern interrupts, sound effects, music, voiceovers, product demonstrations, and CTAs



-Create multiple hooks, intros, angles, and variations for the same product



-Create ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms



What We Are Looking For



-Strong experience creating ecommerce or dropshipping video ads



-Excellent video editing skills



-Strong understanding of direct-response advertising and customer psychology



-Experience with modern AI video and image generation tools



-Ability to create realistic AI footage based on AliExpress product images and videos



-Ability to independently research products, competitors, customers, and existing ads



-Strong understanding of hooks, angles, storytelling, retention, and CTAs



-Ability to turn an AliExpress product link into a complete professional video ad without needing detailed instructions



AI Experience



You should be comfortable using AI for video generation, image generation, AI UGC, realistic actors, product visualization, voiceovers, image-to-video generation, lip syncing, scene creation, and improving existing product footage.



The specific tools you use are less important than the quality and realism of the final result.



When Applying



1-Send examples of ecommerce video ads you personally created



2-Send examples where you received only a product or product link and created the complete ad yourself



3-Send your best examples of AI-generated product footage, AI UGC, or AI video ads



4-For your examples, explain exactly what you were responsible for: research, angles, hooks, scripts, footage sourcing, AI generation, editing, voiceovers, captions, and CTAs



5-Tell us which AI and video editing tools you currently use



6-Explain your complete process if we give you only an AliExpress product link



7-How long does it normally take you to create one complete 20–45 second video ad from beginning to end, including research, scripting, sourcing or generating footage, and editing?



8-How many complete video ads can you realistically create per working day?

title: # AI WEBSITE BUILDER / WEB DEVELOPER
description:
### Freelance / Gig Position • Recurring Projects • Remote



We are looking for a talented **AI-assisted Web Designer / Web Developer** to work with us on a project-by-project basis.



This is **not a full-time position**. We generate our own business leads and will contact you whenever we have a website project that needs to be built.



**You do not need to find customers. We provide the clients and projects — you build the websites.**



There is potential for recurring work for the right person as our business grows.



## WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We need someone who has both **web design and web development skills**.



You should understand not only how to build a website, but also **how a professional website should look and feel.**



You should have a good eye for:



* Professional website design

* Layout and structure

* Typography and spacing

* Colors and branding

* Mobile responsiveness

* User experience

* Clear calls-to-action

* Professional presentation

* What makes a website look modern and trustworthy



We do not want someone who simply puts information into a template.



We want someone who can take a basic business and turn its information into a **clean, professional-looking website.**



## 1. FAST AI WEBSITE CREATION — REQUIRED



You must be experienced with modern AI website-building and AI development tools.



For simple business websites, we want someone who can work **very quickly and efficiently**.



A typical basic website should ideally be completed **within 24 hours**, depending on the project and how quickly the required information is provided.



Simple websites may include:



* Home

* About

* Services

* Contact

* Gallery

* Reviews

* Basic lead/contact forms



The purpose is to create a professional website without spending unnecessary hours manually building something that AI can help create much faster.



## 2. BASE44 EXPERIENCE — HUGE PLUS ⭐



**Experience with Base44 is a HUGE plus.**



If you have experience using **Base44** to create websites, web applications, or custom business tools, please mention it prominently in your application.



We are particularly interested in developers who understand how to use AI-powered platforms such as Base44 to **rapidly build functional websites and web applications.**



Base44 experience is not required, but candidates who already know the platform will have a significant advantage.



## 3. MANUAL WEB DEVELOPMENT — REQUIRED



You must also have real web-development skills.



If a customer wants something beyond a basic AI-generated website, you should be able to build, customize, or troubleshoot it yourself.



Examples include:



* Custom website functionality

* Booking systems

* Forms and integrations

* Customer portals

* Dashboards

* Web applications

* API integrations

* Database functionality

* Custom features



We want someone who knows when to use AI and when to **code and develop manually.**



## AI EXPERIENCE



We specifically want someone who knows how to use AI to make web development **faster and more efficient**.



Experience with tools such as:



* Base44

* ChatGPT

* Claude

* AI website builders

* AI coding assistants

* Other AI development tools



is highly valuable.



**AI should help you work faster — not replace your actual knowledge of web design and development.**



## RESPONSIBILITIES



* Build professional websites for our clients

* Use AI tools to speed up development

* Design websites that look modern and professional

* Customize websites according to each client's business

* Add business information, images, services, branding, and content

* Make websites responsive on desktop and mobile

* Make revisions when needed

* Troubleshoot technical issues

* Build custom features for more advanced projects

* Communicate clearly about project requirements

* Complete projects quickly and meet deadlines



## REQUIREMENTS



**REQUIRED:**



* Proven experience in **web design AND web development**

* Strong understanding of what makes a website look professional

* Experience building websites using AI

* Ability to build/customize websites manually

* Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and/or modern web development

* Strong attention to design and detail

* **Fast worker who can complete projects efficiently**

* Able to work independently

* Good English communication skills



**HUGE PLUS:**



* Base44 experience

* Experience building web applications

* Experience with AI-powered development platforms

* Experience with APIs, databases, and integrations



## PORTFOLIO — VERY IMPORTANT



**You MUST provide examples of websites you have personally built.**



We are interested in seeing websites you have created:



* Using AI

* Using Base44

* Using website builders

* Completely from scratch

* Or a combination of AI and manual development



Please provide **multiple examples** if possible.



We will evaluate both the **technical quality and visual design** of your work.



Applications without examples of previous website work will not be considered.



## DOMAIN, HOSTING & BUSINESS COSTS



**You will NOT be responsible for paying for domains, hosting, or other required business expenses out of your own pocket.**



The company will cover the costs of:



* Domain registration

* Website hosting

* Required business subscriptions

* Other necessary website infrastructure



Your compensation is for your **time, skills, design, and development work.**



We will provide the necessary information and access required for the projects.



## COMPENSATION



This is a **project-based freelance/gig position**, not a traditional full-time position.



For simple AI-assisted business websites, the expected budget will generally be approximately **$15–$25 per website**, depending on the project and scope.



More advanced websites, custom development, and web applications will be quoted separately based on complexity.



There is potential for **consistent recurring work** for the right person.



## IMPORTANT — WE NEED A FAST WORKER



Speed is very important for this position.



We are building a business model where we may have multiple website opportunities, so we need someone who can **work quickly and efficiently**.



If you normally take several days to build a simple business website, this position may not be a good fit.



We are looking for someone who can use AI and their existing skills to produce a professional result **quickly.**



## HOW TO APPLY



Please provide the following:



**1. Portfolio:**

Send links to several websites you personally built.



**2. Base44 Experience:**

Have you used Base44? If yes, tell us what you have built with it and provide examples if possible.



**3. AI Experience:**

Tell us which AI tools you use for web design/development.



**4. Development Skills:**

What programming languages, frameworks, or platforms are you comfortable with?



**5. Experience:**

How many years have you been building websites?



**6. Speed:**

Approximately how long would it take you to create a professional 4–5 page website for a local business?



**7. Web Apps:**

Have you built a web application or custom web functionality before? If yes, provide an example.



**8. Design:**

What do you believe makes a small-business website look professional and trustworthy?



Please provide **real examples of your work**. We are much more interested in seeing what you have actually built than reading a long résumé.



### KEY SKILLS



**Web Design | AI Website Development | Base44 | Web Development | UI/UX | AI Coding Tools | Web Applications**

title: Australia-based Ecommerce Operations and Warehouse Fulfillment Manager. Dayshift!
description:
Oz Best Dealz is one of Australia’s fastest-growing 4x4 accessories retailers, with over 2000 SKU's. We operate a warehouse and e-commerce business currently powered by Neto (Maropost). With rapid growth, we’re looking for an experienced operations professional to take over and streamline fulfilment, warehousing, system integrations, and shipping operations.



Your Role



As the E-Commerce Operations & Fulfilment Manager, you’ll be the backbone of our operations, overseeing how stock flows from suppliers to our warehouse to our customers.



Responsibilities



-Warehouse & Fulfilment

-Set up and manage warehouse zones (e.g., pick faces, bulk storage, returns)

-Design efficient picking, packing, and dispatch workflows

-Oversee day-to-day warehouse system operations and troubleshoot issues



Technology & Systems



-Manage and optimize Neto/Maropost or help us migrate if necessary

-Integrate warehouse and courier systems (Starshipit, ShipStation, AusPost, Aramex, etc.)

-Implement automation and apps that improve efficiency and customer experience



Inventory & Purchasing



-Oversee stock levels, reordering, and supplier purchase orders

-Set up auto-alerts and replenishment rules based on sell-through rates

-Reduce dead stock and optimize inventory turnover





Shipping & Logistics



-Set up and manage shipping options, rates, and rules for our website

-Ensure courier integrations run smoothly (label generation, tracking, etc.)

-Minimize order errors, shipping delays, and fulfilment costs





Team & Reporting



-Work with or train pick/pack staff (if in-house)

-Develop SOPs and training docs

-Provide regular reports on order fulfilment KPIs, warehouse performance, and inventory accuracy





You Bring:



At least 3 years of experience in e-commerce operations or fulfilment is required

Proficiency with WMS and platforms like Neto/Maropost, Shopify, Dear, or Cin7

Hands-on experience with courier integrations and shipping logistics

Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, and a process-driven mindset

Excellent communication and leadership skills



Bonus: Background in 4x4, automotive, or retail/e-commerce industry



Checked all the boxes?  Then your mission is simple: complete the Google Form and help us discover the next operations superstar (hint: it might be you)!

title: Remote Marketing & CRM Operations
description:
Are you a detail-oriented, tech-savvy Virtual Professional who enjoys working behind the scenes to keep systems clean, connected, and reliable?



We’re looking for a proactive VP of Backend Operations & CRM Systems to support a high-performing service business by maintaining accurate data flow across HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow. This role is ideal for someone who is organized, systems-minded, comfortable troubleshooting platform issues, and able to help leadership pull accurate reports on leads, appointments, and revenue by source.



This is not a strategy role. The focus is on backend operations, data accuracy, CRM cleanup, reporting support, and workflow efficiency.



What You’ll Do



You’ll support day-to-day backend operations by helping ensure the client’s tools are properly set up, connected, and producing clean, reliable data.



CRM, Reporting & Data Management

• Review and clean up HubSpot data to ensure leads, appointments, deals, and revenue are accurately tracked.

• Help build and maintain HubSpot reports that leadership can easily pull and trust.

• Check that data from CallRail, web forms, Vendo, and Arrivy maps correctly into HubSpot.

• Identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent lead source data and help correct it.

• Maintain clean deal records, contact records, and source attribution where needed.



CallRail, RingCentral & Source Attribution Support

• Review CallRail tracking numbers and confirm they are assigned to the correct lead sources, such as Google Ads, LSA, organic, referral, or outbound campaigns.

• Help clean up source attribution issues where outbound calls are incorrectly tagged under sales reps rather than the proper source categories.

• Support workflow improvements between CallRail and RingCentral to reduce platform-switching friction for the call center team.

• Document issues, patterns, and recommended fixes clearly.



Platform & Workflow Support

• Review the flow of information from HubSpot to Arrivy, Vendo, and back to HubSpot.

• Help troubleshoot minor system issues and coordinate with platform support teams when needed.

• Assist with routine Webflow content updates and minor website maintenance.

• Clearly document processes, updates, and recurring tasks so the team has reliable SOPs.



Admin & Communication Support

• Communicate clearly with the client, team members, and vendor/platform support teams.

• Provide regular updates on progress, blockers, and completed tasks.

• Use AI tools responsibly to improve documentation, reporting, and written communication.

• Maintain organized records, task lists, and process guides.



Who We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and comfortable working across multiple systems. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be confident in learning platforms, checking integrations, and spotting data inconsistencies.



You may be a great fit if you:



• Have strong English communication skills, especially in written updates and documentation.

• Are detail-oriented and can spot inconsistencies in data, reports, workflows, and CRM records.

• Are tech-savvy and comfortable learning tools like HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow.

• Have experience with CRM management, reporting, lead tracking, or sales operations support.

• Can follow instructions carefully while also thinking ahead and identifying potential issues.

• Are proactive, resourceful, and willing to explore possible solutions before escalating.

• Can communicate blockers clearly and ask thoughtful questions when context is missing.

• Are comfortable working in a backend support role with limited customer-facing responsibilities.

• Can maintain confidentiality when handling client, customer, sales, and revenue-related data.



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



• HubSpot CRM, pipelines, properties, workflows, reports, or dashboards

• CallRail tracking numbers, call source attribution, or lead source cleanup

• RingCentral or other VoIP/call center platforms

• Webflow content updates or website maintenance

• Sales operations, marketing operations, or CRM administration

• Process documentation, SOP creation, or backend operations support

• Google Sheets, Excel, or reporting/data cleanup tasks



Tech & Infrastructure Requirements: To ensure a smooth and efficient remote work experience, applicants must have:

• Intel i5 10th Gen or AMD Ryzen 5 (or higher)

• Minimum 8GB RAM

• Device (laptop or PC) must be less than 3 years old

• Stable internet: 50–100 Mbps, with a backup connection

• Quality webcam, mic, and headset

Screenshots of your device specs and an internet speed test will be required upon application.



Why You’ll Love Working with Claud?

• Paid holidays & PTO

• HMO (after 1st year)

• Family Medical Incentive

• PAG-IBIG & referral incentives

• Weekends off

• Free learning sessions & fun company events

• Supportive, growth-driven remote community



Let's Get to Know You: Please include your answers to the following in your application :

1. In one paragraph, tell us about yourself.

2. What are your key strengths that would help you excel in this role?

3. What challenges do you foresee in this role?



Don’t just look for a job - build a meaningful career filled with freedom, balance, and the support you deserve.



Apply today!

title: Full-Time Video Editor (DaVinci Resolve) - Testimonial & Talking-Head Content
description:
Before anything else: if you're replying to this with something AI wrote for you, don't bother, I can tell and I'll just skip the application. If you're a real editor who actually wants this, start your message with a link to one testimonial or talking-head style video you think can convert as a paid-ad, and one sentence on why. That's the only test before we talk properly, and it also tells me if you actually know what makes this kind of video good. If you have no experience, but is willing to learn, we'll be offering training so you can LEVEL UP. We believe in hiring people who are quick to learn through constructive feedback, andbuild skills that they can use FOREVER.



I run DTM Media, a small video agency in Melbourne. We make short-form content for a couple of retainer clients, mostly testimonial and talking-head videos, the kind that live or die on the first three seconds and can't afford a boring middle. Right now we're overloaded with edits, and want frequent variations to creatives to reduce fatigue! We also do more creative edits, and if you are capable and have a style of editing we like - we'll be down to get you onboard aswell :)



This is a full-time role - I want someone constantly on the ball! However, I am very flexible - if you can get the work done I am happy to pay by edit/project and organise other flexible hourly/per project basis. I will still pay during the training phase!



What the job actually is: cutting testimonial and talking-head videos to batches of potential videos that can be created for paid ads - ensuring there is clear pacing, captions, hook, and CTA. There's also some general admin and other small production tasks that come up, this isn't a role where you only ever touch one thing.



You'll get a proper written/visual guide and training directly from the team before you start covering exactly what "good" looks like for our videos, so you're not guessing. There's also a short paid test project first, real but small, so you can show me what you've got and I can see if this is a fit before either of us commits further. We'll have two styles - one focused around talking head, and another that is more creative (like real estate). 



Straight talk on commitment: I'm hiring for the next couple of months to start. If it's working, and I think it will if you're genuinely good at this, there's a real path to staying long-term. I'd rather build with one person over time than keep restarting every few months. And even if it doesn't become permanent, real agency client work is a solid thing to have on your record for whatever's next.



What I need: solid DaVinci Resolve skills (color, basic audio, captions, exports). Real experience editing short-form vertical content, TikTok, Reels, testimonials, not just long-form. You can follow a brief exactly instead of doing your own thing with it. You're actually online and reliable during work hours, not just "available when convenient." Good enough written English that a brief lands the first time.



Reply with the video link and your one sentence like I said above, then tell me about your editing background and the hours you're actually free.

title: Online Fitness Coach
description:
About The Role:

Fitribe is looking for a passionate, energetic, and client-focused Online Female Fitness Coach to join our growing coaching team full-time.This role is ideal for someone who genuinely loves helping women improve their health, confidence, and lifestyle through sustainable fitness and nutrition habits. You'll work closely with clients to provide accountability, support, education, and guidance throughout their journey. Fluent and Perfect English is required



Our coaching philosophy is built around consistency, community, and long-term results rather than quick fixes, so we're looking for a coach who shares those values.



While experience in nutrition, exercise science, physical therapy, or other health-related fields is highly valued, what matters most is your ability to connect with clients, deliver exceptional coaching, and help people achieve lasting results.



Key Responsibilities

- Voiced and Messaging Client Coaching & Support

- Deliver a high level of coaching support through Trainerize and other communication platforms.

- Build strong relationships with clients through regular communication and accountability.

- Provide personalised feedback, encouragement, and guidance to help clients stay engaged and motivated.

- Monitor client progress and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.

- Support clients through challenges, barriers, and setbacks while maintaining a positive coaching experience.



Program Management:

- Design and adjust personalised training programs based on client goals, experience level, injuries, and lifestyle factors.

- Review client data including workouts, nutrition logs, progress photos, measurements, and check-ins.

- Make program adjustments as needed to ensure continued progress and adherence.



Client Experience:

- Maintain timely responses to client messages and support requests.

- Conduct regular check-ins and follow-up communication.

- Deliver a supportive, professional, and empathetic coaching experience.

- Contribute to client retention through proactive engagement and relationship building.



Team Collaboration:

- Work closely with the coaching and operations teams.

- Participate in team meetings and performance reviews.

- Contribute ideas to improve systems, processes, and client outcomes.



Essential Requirements:

- Female fitness coach or personal trainer.

- Previous experience coaching clients online or in person.

- Strong understanding of strength training, fat loss, habit formation, and client accountability.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Highly organised with strong time management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple clients while maintaining a high level of service.

- Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment.

- Positive attitude with a genuine passion for helping others succeed.

- Preferred Experience



While not required, the following experience will be highly regarded:

Trainerize experience.

Nutrition coaching experience.

Experience coaching women in perimenopause and menopause.

Exercise Science qualification.

Personal Training certification.

Strength and Conditioning qualification.

Physical Therapy, Allied Health, or Rehabilitation background.

Experience working within an online coaching business.

What We're Looking For



The ideal coach is:

Empathetic and approachable.

Professional and reliable.

Proactive rather than reactive.

Comfortable building relationships through online communication.

Passionate about creating long-term lifestyle change.

Committed to providing an outstanding client experience.



**SUPER IMPORTANT REMINDERS BELOW**

To be considered for this role, please submit:

1. Resume/CV

Your most up-to-date resume outlining your experience and qualifications.

Tell us a little about yourself, your coaching experience, and why you'd be a great fit for Fitribe.

title: Creative Strategist Meta Ads
description:
we're a creative strategy studio. we build the ad creative DTC brands run on meta, and we're hiring one strategist onto our core team full time.

what you'd be doing



you'd start on 1 brand. around 5 batches a week.



a batch for us is 1 concept, 1 motivator, built out in 3 different formats. ai voiceover, lo-fi static, text-over-b-roll. not 1 script with 3 hooks on top of it. meta reads that as the same ad anyway.



you research the customer, find the angle, write the script, and brief it so an editor can shoot it without asking you a single question. then you look at what the ads did and d
 what to write next.



what we need to see



ads you briefed that ran behind $50k+ in spend, with proof. ads manager screenshots are fine. this one isn't flexible. writing for a brand spending real money is a different job to writing for one testing $20 a day.



the results on those ads. roas, cpa, hook rate, whatever you track.



the brief or the script you wrote for them. we want to see how you direct, not just the finished thing.



the final edited ads.



if you can't send all 4, you're not ready for this one yet. that's fine, come back when you are.



who we're looking for



someone reliable. the batch lands when you said it would, every week, and i'm not chasing it. that one thing gets people promoted here faster than talent does.



someone who wants to grow inside a team. you'd be sitting next to other strategists, getting feedback on every brief, and eventually giving it. if being reviewed every week sounds annoying instead of useful, this isn't the room.



someone who studies this properly. if you've read breakthrough advertising, or scientific advertising, or the boron letters, tell us. if you haven't read anything and you've picked it all up on the job, just say that. we'd rather hear it. but the strategists who go furthest here are the ones who read.



the money



$1.5k to $2k a month depending on how many brands you're holding.



you move up when you can hold the brand you already have. not on time served. same rule for everyone and it's written down, so you never have to ask me for a raise.



hours



online 8am to 3pm EST. that's when edit reviews, briefing and scripting happen, so a strategist who's asleep through it slows the whole batch down. there's some flex on the exact overlap and we'll talk about it, but we need to see you in that window most days.



how we hire



1 test batch.,24 hours. real brand, real work. if it's good you start the week after.



how to apply



send the 4 things above.



then tell me, in your own words, the last ad that stopped you scrolling and what made it work.



write that part yourself. we read a lot of ai copy every week and we clock it straight away. 3 honest sentences beat a clean paragraph you didn't write.

title: Shopify Product Lister & Merchandiser (Remote, Part-Time / Freelance)
description:
We're looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed Product Lister to own our Shopify product pages end-to-end; not just data entry, but someone who catches what's wrong, adapts content for the UK market, and thinks about merchandising, not just uploading.



What you'll do

- Edit and proofread product page content on Shopify: titles, descriptions, variants, pricing, tags, sizing, and collection tags, catching typos, inconsistencies, and factual errors before they go live

- Judge whether existing product photos are good enough for the page or need to be swapped - flag or source replacements when quality, angle, or styling isn't cutting it

- Adapt all product content (sizing conventions, spelling, tone, seasonal relevance) specifically for the UK market, not a generic English-language version

- Check that Meta ad creatives match their landing pages - same product, same offer, same visual language - and flag or fix mismatches before they burn ad spend

- Build and launch new collections aligned with the season, trends, and what's actually selling - this includes d
 what to group together and how to present it, not just following a list

- Bring new insights proactively: what's underperforming, what's trending in the UK market, what competitors are doing differently, what product gaps exist

- Keep inventory, pricing, and variant data accurate and current across the board



What we expect

- Strong attention to detail - nothing ships with a typo, a mismatched photo, or a broken price

- Genuine merchandising instinct - you can look at a product page or a collection and tell what's working and what isn't, not just execute a checklist

- Familiarity with the UK fashion e-commerce market (or the ability to research it properly)

- Comfortable working independently, meeting output targets, and flagging issues before they become problems - this role needs judgment, not just hands

- Prior experience with Shopify (or a similar platform) and ideally exposure to Meta Ads is a strong plus

- Clear, proactive communication - you tell us what you found and what you changed, not just "done"



What we're offering

- Remote, flexible hours, part
 (per-task or hourly - open to discussing)

- Real ownership over product pages and collections, with room to grow into more strategic merchandising responsibility as you prove reliable

- Clear expectations set upfront, so there's no ambiguity about what "done well" looks like



Note on our hiring process



We run a short paid trial period before confirming any ongoing arrangement. This lets both sides confirm the pace, judgment, and quality expected are a good fit. We're specifically looking for someone efficient and sharp-eyed. If you need to be told exactly what's wrong with a page rather than spotting it yourself, this role won't be a fit, and that's fine, just not what we need right now.



To apply: send your CV/portfolio (or Shopify store links you've worked on, if any) along with your availability (hours/days per week) and your expected rate.



Include the word "Monaco" somewhere in your application. Applications without it won't be considered.

title: Real Estate Video Editor | Luxury Property Films & Agent Reels
description:
I'm Harrison, founder of Macourt Media in Sydney. We create property films and social content for real estate agents, and I'm looking for an editor with strong taste who can take ownership of an edit from raw footage to delivery.



You'll work on premium property films, vertical walkthroughs and agent reels. The aim is to make the home look beautiful and the agent feel natural, with a clear story and editing that suits the property.



The work needs:



- Natural, consistent colour. Clean whites, believable skin tones and timber, controlled highlights, and interiors that match from shot to shot.

- Strong shot selection, spatial flow and pacing. Know when to hold a beautiful shot and when to move the edit along.

- Thoughtful music and sound design, clear dialogue and balanced audio.

- Clean captions and motion graphics, plus confident masking, tracking and speed ramps where they improve the film.

- Organised projects, reliable exports and tidy handover files.



You should be confident in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, with After Effects or Fusion skills where needed. Strong Final Cut editors are also welcome if they can provide a workable project handover.



I value people who notice things: a missing shot, a colour mismatch, an unclear brief or a better opening. You should ask useful questions, suggest improvements, flag delays early and apply feedback without needing every detail spelled out.



This is a full-time remote role, 40 hours per week. The salary range is US$1,200–1,600 per month depending on your work and the paid test. Please tell us your availability for overlap with Sydney business hours.



To apply, please send:



1. Three direct video links: your two strongest property films and one agent or social reel. Choose individual videos that play without an access request. A portfolio homepage can be included as an extra.

2. For each video, tell us exactly what you did: editing, colour, sound, graphics and/or filming. Clearly label team work and practice edits.

3. Tell us which of the three is your strongest, why you made one specific editing choice, and one thing you would improve now. A few sentences is enough.

4. Your software, expected monthly pay in USD for 40 hours per week, current work commitments, available start date and Sydney overlap.

5. Your editing Instagram account, if you use one. This is optional.



Shortlisted editors will be invited to a paid editing test using the same footage and brief. The test will include one feedback round and a short project walkthrough. There is no unpaid test required to apply.



We're looking for someone who cares about the finished work and wants to build a strong working relationship.

title: Senior Bookkeeper (Philippines) – Canadian Clients
description:
We are a Canadian accounting firm seeking a highly experienced Senior Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support and oversee bookkeeping work for a portfolio of Canadian small-business clients. This role requires a deep understanding of Canadian bookkeeping standards, strong analytical skills, and the ability to produce client-ready work with minimal supervision. Part-time and full-time applicants will be considered.



About the Role



As a Senior Bookkeeper, you will take ownership of complete bookkeeping cycles, perform complex reconciliations, clean up historical issues, and ensure accurate financial reporting. You must be exceptionally detail-oriented and able to work independently while maintaining high professional standards. You will serve as a key support to the accounting team and help maintain consistency and quality across client files.



Key Responsibilities



Lead full-cycle bookkeeping for multiple Canadian corporations

Perform advanced bank, credit card, loan, and intercompany reconciliations

Month-end and year-end close procedures, including adjusting entries

Prepare and review draft financial statements (Balance Sheet, P&L)

Clean up and standardize books for new onboarding clients

Manage AR/AP cycles, including aging analysis

Prepare and file GST/HST and QST returns (mandatory)

Identify errors, incorrect postings, and root causes; propose corrective actions

Support compilation (NTR) and tax prep workflows by providing year-end schedules

Collaborate with accountants to finalize month-end and year-end work

Ensure documentation and workpapers meet firm standards

Communicate effectively with the accounting team and escalate issues proactively



Required Skills & Experience



Mandatory: Minimum 4–5+ years of Canadian bookkeeping experience

Mandatory: Strong working knowledge of GST/HST and QST

Proven experience handling bookkeeping for Canadian small businesses

Advanced QuickBooks Online skills (bank rules, cleanup, custom reports, etc.)

Strong understanding of ASPE basics as related to bookkeeping

Ability to work independently and produce clean, accurate work

Experience performing cleanup of messy or incomplete books

Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)

High level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism

Exceptional attention to detail—errors or sloppy work are not tolerated in this role



Nice-to-Have



Prior work in a Canadian accounting firm

Experience preparing year-end schedules for accountants

Knowledge of Canadian payroll posting and reconciliation

Familiarity with tools such as Dext, Hubdoc, Financial Cents, Harvest, or similar



Critical Screening Note



Applicants who cannot demonstrate strong, hands-on bookkeeping experience with Canadian clients will not be considered.

Only candidates with proven knowledge of Canadian bookkeeping standards and sales tax rules (GST/HST/QST) should apply.



Work Arrangement



Fully remote (Philippines-based)

Part-time or full-time considered

Must have some overlap with Canadian business hours

Long-term role with consistent work and performance-based growth



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your updated CV

A summary of your Canadian bookkeeping experience (mandatory)

Examples of Canadian tasks you have personally handled (GST/HST/QST filings, month-end close, cleanup work, etc.)

Your availability (PT or FT)

Your expected hourly or monthly rate

title: Cybersecurity Specialist
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a detail-oriented Cybersecurity Monitoring Analyst to help protect our organization's systems, endpoints, and network infrastructure. This role is responsible for day-to-day security monitoring, log analysis, and reporting, with a strong emphasis on identifying risks early and recommending practical improvements to our security posture.



Key Responsibilities

- Monitor and manage endpoint security using Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Bitdefender

- Configure, monitor, and maintain Cloudflare for network/web security, DNS, and traffic filtering

- Review and analyze security logs and alerts across endpoints, network, and cloud services to identify suspicious activity

- Prepare and distribute a daily cybersecurity status report summarizing threats detected, i
, alerts, and overall security health

- Investigate and triage security alerts, escalating confirmed i
 according to established procedures

- Proactively identify gaps or weaknesses in current security tools and configurations

- Recommend and help implement improvements to strengthen the organization's security posture

- Maintain documentation of security events, responses, and remediation steps

- Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and best practices relevant to the tools in use



Required Skills & Experience



- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (or comparable Microsoft security tools)

- Experience with Cloudflare (or similar web/DNS/network security platforms)

- Strong ability to read, interpret, and act on cybersecurity logs and alerts

- Experience with Bitdefender or similar endpoint protection platforms

- Demonstrated experience producing clear, concise security status reports for stakeholders

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the judgment to prioritize real threats

- Ability to work independently and maintain a consistent daily monitoring routine



Preferred / Desired Skills



- Ability to go beyond monitoring — proactively recommending and helping implement security improvements

- Familiarity with SIEM tools or log aggregation platforms

- Understanding of network security fundamentals (firewalls, DNS, VPNs)

- Experience with vulnerability management or patch management processes

- Relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, Network+, CEH, or similar) a plus

- Familiarity with i
 response procedures

- Basic scripting/automation skills (PowerShell, Python) for report generation or alert handling, a plus

- Web administration and design skills (e.g., website management, basic front-end/design work) a plus



What We're Looking For



We value a candidate who doesn't just watch dashboards, but thinks critically about why alerts happen and how our defenses could be stronger. If you're the kind of person who spots a pattern in the logs and immediately starts thinking about the fix, we want to hear from you.



Please send the following:

1. A short description of your IT/cybersecurity experience.

2. Which areas from the list above you know best.

3. What tools or software you regularly use.

title: PERSONAL BRAND CONTENT CREATOR + VIRTUAL ASSISTANT
description:
PERSONAL BRAND CONTENT CREATOR + VIRTUAL ASSISTANT



Part-Time | Approximately 5 Hours/Week to Start | Long-Term Opportunity



Hi! I'm Katelyn, a women's health nurse practitioner, business owner, and busy mom in the United States.



I'm looking for a creative, highly organized Virtual Assistant who can help me with a combination of personal-brand social media content and general executive/personal assistant tasks.



Social media is an important part of this role, so you MUST be skilled at creating modern, engaging personal-brand content and editing short-form video. However, I'm still developing my personal social media presence, so I don't expect social media to be the only thing you do.



I'm ultimately looking for someone who can help take things off my plate.



WHAT YOU'LL HELP WITH



SOCIAL MEDIA + PERSONAL BRAND



My personal Instagram combines women's health education with business ownership, motherhood, working-mom life, behind-the-scenes moments, humor, and everyday life.



I will provide raw content such as talking-head videos, photos, random clips, voice notes, screenshots, and rough ideas.



You may help with:



* Editing Instagram Reels and short-form video

* Creating hooks, captions, on-screen text, B-roll, and Reel covers

* Creating simple carousels and graphics

* Turning voice notes or rough thoughts into content ideas

* Repurposing longer content into shorter pieces

* Organizing my raw photos/videos and content library

* Keeping track of content ideas

* Identifying trends or content opportunities that fit my personality

* Preparing and scheduling approved content



I do NOT want my personal account to look like a corporate healthcare account.



The style should feel modern, feminine, conversational, intelligent, warm, relatable, sometimes funny, and REAL.



VIRTUAL ASSISTANT + PERSONAL/EXECUTIVE SUPPORT



Depending on the week, you may also help me with things like:



* Online research and comparison shopping

* Researching products, services, travel, vendors, or other options and summarizing the best choices

* Organizing files, Google Drive folders, photos, and documents

* Maintaining task lists and helping track things I need to follow up on

* Basic scheduling and calendar support

* Travel research and itinerary organization

* Gift research and other personal-life logistics

* Research related to my professional brand, speaking opportunities, podcasts, etc.

* Formatting documents or organizing information

* Basic online administrative tasks

* Other projects that help reduce the day-to-day mental load of being a business owner and working mom



Some weeks may be more focused on content. Other weeks may have more VA/personal-assistant work.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



I would love to find someone who is BOTH creative and extremely organized.



You should:



* Have experience creating PERSONAL BRAND social media content

* Be skilled at Instagram Reels and short-form video editing

* Have a strong visual/aesthetic eye

* Be comfortable using Canva and video editing software such as CapCut or similar

* Understand modern Instagram content, hooks, pacing, B-roll, captions, and trends

* Be highly organized and detail-oriented

* Be a strong online researcher

* Have excellent written English

* Be resourceful and comfortable figuring things out independently

* Communicate reliably

* Follow through on tasks without needing constant reminders

* Be comfortable receiving feedback

* Be interested in a long-term working relationship



Most importantly, I want someone who is proactive.



If I send you a messy folder of videos, photos, screenshots, voice notes, and random ideas, I want you to be the kind of person who enjoys turning that chaos into something useful.



HOURS + PAY



Approximately 5 hours per week to start.



Starting rate: $6-$8 USD/hour depending on experience and portfolio.



This will begin with a trial period. If we work well together, there is potential for additional hours and responsibilities over time.



I'm looking for a long-term relationship with the right person.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and why you think you would be a good fit for this combination of creative and VA work.



2. Links to 3-5 Reels or short-form videos YOU personally edited or created.



3. Tell me exactly what you personally did on those pieces.



4. A link to your portfolio or other work.



5. Tell me about your experience as a VA, executive assistant, or personal assistant, if applicable.



6. Give me an example of a time a client gave you a vague or messy task and you independently figured out how to complete it.



7. Tell me which apps/programs you regularly use for video editing, Canva/design, organization, and productivity.



8. Tell me your desired hourly rate in USD.



IMPORTANT: Begin your application with the words "COKE ZERO" so I know you read the entire posting.



PAID TEST



Finalists will be invited to complete a paid test.



The test will include a short social media editing project and a small research/organization task so I can evaluate both sides of the role.



I'm looking for someone who can be creative when I need creative help, organized when I need organization, and ultimately make my life a little easier.



If that sounds like you, I'd love to hear from you!

PORTFOLIO REQUIRED

Please send links to your 3 best examples.

title: Full-Time Cold Caller – U.S. Vacant Land Real Estate
description:
We are a U.S.-based real estate investment company looking for a professional, motivated, full-time Cold Caller to join our growing team.



Your primary responsibility will be calling owners of vacant land from targeted lists, following our provided script, identifying motivated sellers, collecting specific information, and submitting qualified leads through our CRM webform.



This is a long-term position for the right person. We are looking for someone dependable, coachable, naturally warm and friendly on the phone, and interested in growing with our company. The right caller should make property owners feel comfortable and respected—not sound robotic, aggressive, or pushy.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Make high-volume outbound calls to U.S. vacant-land owners

- Follow our provided cold-calling script consistently

- Speak professionally and confidently with property owners

- Identify owners interested in selling

- Ask all required qualification questions

- Gather seller price expectations, negotiability, timeline, motivation, and property information

- Enter qualified leads accurately into our CRM webform

- Keep seller names, phone numbers, property information, and notes accurate and organized

- Meet daily activity and qualified-lead goals

- Communicate with management regarding performance, list quality, and issues



REQUIREMENTS



- Excellent spoken and written English

- Clear, confident, professional phone voice

- Naturally warm, pleasant, and friendly conversational style

- Previous cold-calling, telemarketing, sales, or real-estate experience strongly preferred

- Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls every day

- Able to follow a script without constantly changing or improvising it

- Strong attention to detail

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Quiet, professional workspace

- Dependable computer and headset

- Reliable attendance

- Available to work U.S. business hours

- Full-time availability — 40 hours per week

- Coachable, positive attitude and willing to receive call feedback



Vacant-land experience is helpful but not required. We will provide training, scripts, systems, and clear expectations.



COMPENSATION



Starting pay is four to five U.S. dollars per hour, depending on relevant experience and performance.



40 hours per week, Monday–Friday.



BONUS INCENTIVES



In addition to hourly pay, bonus incentives will be awarded when a qualified lead you generate results in a successfully closed real estate deal. Lead attribution will be tracked through our CRM, so accurate notes and lead submission are essential. Bonus details and eligibility will be explained during the interview.



There will be an initial training and performance evaluation period.



CONFIDENTIALITY



This is a trusted position involving confidential business, seller, property, lead, CRM, and company information.



The selected candidate will be required to sign a Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement before receiving access to company systems or proprietary information.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



1. Send a basic résumé summarizing your relevant work experience.

2. Briefly describe your cold-calling, appointment-setting, or sales experience.

3. Tell us what types of campaigns or industries you have called for.

4. Confirm that you are available to work 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours.

5. Tell us what equipment, internet connection, and backup internet/power you have.

6. Include a 30–60-second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a strong cold caller for this position.



Shortlisted applicants will receive the private Google Meet or Zoom interview link through OnlineJobs.ph. Please do not request the link unless you are invited.



IMPORTANT: Applications that do not answer the questions above will not be considered.



We are looking to hire quickly and begin training immediately.

title: Outbound Patient Reactivation Caller for Canadian Dental Offices
description:
READ THIS FIRST - applications without a recording get deleted unread.



Record ONE voice clip of about 90 seconds (a phone voice memo is fine) covering BOTH of these calls:



CALL 1 - a patient in pain. You reach a patient who tells you they have had a sore tooth for over a week and have been putting off coming in. Open the call and take it from there.



CALL 2 - a patient who left unhappy. You are calling a patient who is 14 months overdue for a cleaning. Their last visit was a filling that felt rushed to them and they have not been back since. They pick up, tell you they are not sure it is worth coming back, and say money is tight right now. Handle it.



Somewhere in the recording, say all four practice names out loud:

- Kelowna Dental Centre

- Yaletown Dentistry in Vancouver

- Brightside Dental in West Kelowna

- Tandem Dental Studio in Vernon



Do not script it word for word. I want your natural tone and pacing, how you show empathy, and how you handle it when someone pushes back.



Upload the clip to Vocaroo, Google Drive or Loom and put the link in the FIRST LINE of your application. Then tell me:

1. Which hours you can work between 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM Pacific, and your earliest start date.

2. Which hours inside the calling window below you plan to work, and your earliest start date.



Previous experience in a dental office ranks higher.



----------



COMPENSATION

Base: $800 USD per month.

Plus $10 USD for every reactivated patient who actually attends their appointment. Uncapped.

At 25-40 attended patients per month that works out to roughly $1,050 - $1,200 USD per month.

The bonus is paid on patients who SHOW UP, not on bookings, and is reconciled against the practice's own appointment records. Because attendance is only known after the visit happens, your first bonus arrives about 4-6 weeks after you start.



HOURS

40 hours per week, and you choose when you work them. This is not a fixed shift.

You may call any time between 9:00 AM and 7:30 PM Pacific, seven days a week. No calls outside that window.

You book patients directly into our schedule, so you do not need to be working while the clinic is open.



----------

We are looking for an experienced outbound caller to help reconnect overdue and inactive dental patients with several Canadian dental offices. This role is being filled immediately, and we will be reviewing applications right away.



This role will start with Kelowna Dental Centre and expand to other practices, including Brightside Dental and Tandem Dental in Vernon. You will call patients from approved lists, follow office-specific scripts, book appointments, and document each call clearly.



The right person is warm, compassionate, emotionally mature, and highly organized. You must have excellent interpersonal skills and be comfortable speaking with patients who may be nervous, busy, frustrated, embarrassed, concerned about cost, or hesitant because of a previous visit that did not meet their expectations.



This is not a pushy sales role. It is a patient reactivation and appointment-setting role. You need to listen carefully, acknowledge concerns respectfully, handle objections professionally, and help patients feel comfortable reconnecting with the office. Clinical, billing, complaint, or sensitive questions must be escalated to the appropriate office team.



Responsibilities include calling overdue patients, booking hygiene and follow-up appointments, recording call outcomes, setting follow-up reminders, coordinating with office teams, handling common objections, and escalating concerns when needed.



This is a healthcare-related role, so confidentiality and professionalism are extremely important. You will not provide clinical advice.



Requirements:

- Excellent spoken English

- Warm, compassionate phone presence

- Strong interpersonal and listening skills

- Experience handling objections or difficult conversations

- Experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, customer service, dental reception, healthcare, or sales

- Reliable internet, computer, and headset

- Quiet work environment

- Ability to work during Pacific Time business hours

- Strong attention to detail

- Comfortable using scripts, spreadsheets, calling tools, and CRM-style systems



Dental experience is preferred but not required. Experience with patient recall, hygiene reactivation, service recovery, appointment booking, or complaint handling is a strong asset.



We are hiring immediately.

title: Supply Chain & Logistics Lead: Inventory Planning & Demand Forecasting (Amazon FBA)
description:
We run two complementary e-commerce Amazon FBA brands: one in a premium giftable category with strong Christmas seasonality, one in sports & fitness. We are at ~200 SKUs today, with a clear roadmap to ~500. We sell across Amazon US, UK &.Canada, manufacture in China, and ship into FBA, AWD, and 3PLs across the US, UK, and Canada.



** THE ROLE **



This is a senior role. The CEO and Head of Operations are looking for a trusted operator to take ownership of the supply chain and logistics function, “end-to-end”, from initial forecasting -to- factory floor -to- FBA shelf. Someone we can hand the keys to and trust to drive it forward with little oversight.



You'll inherit a well-documented operation, with a structured onboarding: our current Supply Chain Manager will support your transition, transferring knowledge of both brands, our suppliers, and our systems so you can take the reins with confidence.



We also expect you to work AI-first. The best person for this role uses AI daily: to pressure-test forecasts, draft communications, build formulas, and automate the repetitive parts of logistics coordination. At the same time, you verify every output before it touches a decision. AI leverage is how one sharp operator runs what used to take a full department.



** WHAT YOU WILL OWN **



— Supply chain strategy and execution across both brands, “end-to-end”. Each runs its own forecasting methodology; you'll master both and standardize where it genuinely helps

— Demand forecasting and order planning for 200 SKUs (scaling to 500), built in Google Sheets with the backing of solid data flows

— China manufacturer relationships and procurement: purchase orders (POs): production scheduling, inspections, quality, MOQ and pricing negotiation, alternate sourcing

— International freight and logistics coordination: coordinator of carrier selection, cost vs. transit time, customs compliance, freight forwarders, 3PLs

— FBA inventory health: replenishment timing, 45 to 90 days cover, avoiding stockouts and overstock, inbound receiving discrepancies, reimbursements, cases with Amazon

— The small, critical details: barcodes, FNSKUs, shipment labeling, compliance documentation, tracking reconciliation. You are the last line of defense

— A performance dashboard you build and own: forecast accuracy, inventory turnover, lead time, on-time-in-full, stockout rate, shipping cost per unit, cash-flow planning

— Alignment with marketing and sales (a lightweight S&OP rhythm), so inventory matches promotional plans and seasonality. Flagged early, with numbers

— Task and process management in ClickUp: every shipment, order, supplier action, and follow-up lives in ClickUp so the whole team has visibility, and nothing falls through the cracks. You will be expected to maintain it rigorously, not treat it as optional

— Proactive communication: updates prior to asking, risks flagged early, follow-through without being chased



** WHAT OWNERSHIP MEANS HERE **



In supply chain management, small mistakes compound: one wrong barcode or missed reorder point can be costly. So we work to a clear standard. Sanity checking is built into how you operate: reconciling totals, second-passing formulas, and gut-checking outputs against reality before they drive a decision. Occasional errors are part of the job; what we can't carry is the same error recurring, going unnoticed, or going unexplained. When something does go wrong, you own it: what happened, why, the impact, and the fix that stops it repeating. Work like that, and you'll have our full backing when things go sideways.



** MUST HAVES: SKILLS & EXPERIENCE **



— 4+ years in supply chain or inventory management, with 2+ years personally running an Amazon FBA supply chain “end-to-end” (Bachelor's in Supply Chain or related field is a plus)

— Proven experience managing 100+ SKUs; multi-brand portfolios a plus

— Deep international logistics knowledge: sea freight, customs, import/export compliance

— Strong Seller Central command: restock/capacity limits, IPI, shipment creation, FNSKU and barcode management, AWD vs. FBA

— Hands-on purchasing experience with overseas manufacturers: raising POs, tracking production, reconciling deliveries

— Advanced Google Sheets/Excel. You build models, not just populate them (array formulas, pivot tables, QUERY, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, IMPORTRANGE). We will ask to see analyses you've built.

— Demonstrable AI fluency: real examples of AI saving you hours, and of catching it when it was wrong or hallucinating

— Experience with seasonal products and Christmas demand spikes

— Comfortable delegating and reviewing the work of others when needed

— Fluent English, written and verbal (Mandarin/Chinese a bonus for supplier communications in their native language)



** WORK SETUP **



Reliable electricity and 50+ Mbps internet, your own computer, and a quiet workspace. We run all tasks, processes, and reporting through ClickUp: it is our central hub for visibility across the team, and strong comfort with it is a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Working hours must overlap with China and UK hours (e.g., roughly 2pm to 10pm PH time, or a split shift like PHT 10am to 2pm & 6pm to 10pm). We're flexible on the shape, as long as the crossover is there.



** PERSONALITY WE'RE LOOKING FOR **



A logician's mind: structured, methodical, rigorous. Obsessively detail-oriented, so spotting an off barcode or an ambiguously worded supplier quote is your default mode, not an effort. The right fit is someone with real agency: you push for action, take ownership without waiting to be asked, and juggle parallel priorities without losing oversight of the details. An independent operator and self-starter who stays calm under pressure during peak-season spikes and shipping delays. Fully accountable. Always improving the system.



** NOT A FIT IF YOU **



— Need step-by-step instructions

— Are a generalist VA with peripheral supply chain exposure

— Have not personally managed an FBA supply chain “end-to-end”

— Find details tedious, or paste AI output without checking it

— Are juggling multiple other clients



** THE PACKAGE **



— Full-time, 40 hrs/week; bi-weekly salary (3rd and 18th of the month)

— $1,900 to $2,400+/month base (PHP 120,000 to 150,000+), equivalent to $11 to $14+ per hour, depending on experience

— 13th-month pay, pro-rated each December

— Health reimbursement up to $50/month (HMO, PhilHealth, Maxicare, etc.)



** HOW TO APPLY **



Complete the application form below. It includes a few short questions and two brief video uploads (you can submit partially and return to finish later):

We're into a 5-year vision. We're scaling aggressively in the English-speaking market, and we need editors who grow with us, not editors who disappear when a bigger project comes along, and not a company that goes quiet after 3 months because the brand didn't work out.



We're in this for the long game. We want you to be too.

Position: Direct Response VSL Video Editor (Health/Pain Relief Specialist)

Commitment: Full-time, long-term (this is not a freelance gig)

Compensation: $1,500 monthly + performance bonuses

Location: 100% remote

Market: English-speaking

- Creative ownership, you won't be executing someone else's vision blindly. You'll understand the strategy, the avatar, the psychology behind every piece of content

- A real team, you'll work closely with the founder and marketing lead, not get lost in a ticket queue

Non-negotiable:



- 2+ years editing Direct Response VSLs ads (health/women's wellness a strong plus)

/Instagram ad formats and platform behavior

You care about the work beyond the deliverable. You watch your edited videos after they go live and wonder how to make the next one better. You understand that a 3-second hook isn't decoration, it's the difference between a winning creative and a dead one.



You want to be part of something being built, not just service it.

If you're looking to freelance across 6 clients simultaneously, this isn't the right fit. We want someone who is genuinely invested in one brand's growth, because that's where the real upside is.

ABOUT THE ROLE



YBE Credit Repair is looking to build a high-level credit repair disputing team made up of specialists who are experts in specific areas of credit reporting and dispute resolution.



We are NOT looking for a general VA who has only basic experience sending credit dispute letters.



We are looking for experienced dispute specialists who understand the FCRA, FDCPA, FACTA, Metro 2 reporting, furnisher responsibilities, CRA procedures, and advanced dispute strategies and can independently analyze difficult credit-report situations.



Our goal is to have a specialist for each major dispute category rather than having one person handle everything.



SPECIALIST AREAS WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You do NOT need to be an expert in every category.

Chapter 7 / Chapter 13 reporting issues

Fraudulent accounts

Documentation requirements

CRA/furnisher processes

Complex fraud-related credit-report issues

When applying, DO NOT simply say that you are an “expert in credit repair.”

Late payments

Other

WHAT YOU'LL CREATE

title: Video Editor for Construction Agency
description:
Remote Video Editor – Full-Time

Salary: AUD $800 per fortnight / AUD $1,600 per month

About Sensor Studios



Sensor Studios is one of Australia’s fastest-growing digital content agencies, specialising in the construction and trade industries.



We work with builders, developers, architects, trades and construction brands to create high-quality video content that showcases beautiful homes, impressive projects, skilled workmanship and the people behind each business.



Our videos include project showcases, property reveals, social media reels, advertisements, interviews, educational content and behind-the-scenes footage from construction sites across Australia.



We are now looking for an experienced and highly skilled remote video editor to join our growing team.



About the Role



You will be responsible for producing polished, engaging and consistently high-quality video content for our clients.



This is not simply a role for someone who can cut footage together. We are looking for an editor with a strong creative eye who understands pacing, storytelling, music selection, sound design, colour, transitions and how to make construction and property content feel premium.



You will regularly edit footage featuring:



* Beautiful new homes, renovations and completed projects

* Construction sites and active building work

* Tradespeople and teams working on site

* Property and project reveals

* Interviews and talking-head videos

* Short-form social media content

You will need to balance exceptional quality with speed. We produce a high volume of content, often with tight deadlines, so you must be organised, reliable and capable of maintaining a consistent standard across every project.



Working Schedule



This is a full-time remote position working:



Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday and Monday

8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Sydney, Australia time



These working days are non-negotiable. Please carefully check how Sydney’s time zone, including daylight saving changes, aligns with your local time in the Philippines before applying.



As a guide, this will generally be:

* 5:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. Philippine time when Sydney is on AEDT



What We’re Looking For

* Strong professional video-editing skills

*Use Adobe Premiere Pro

* An excellent understanding of pacing, storytelling and viewer retention

* Experience creating premium-looking social media content

* The ability to use engaging transitions without making edits feel overdone

* Strong music-selection and sound-design skills

* Good colour-grading and audio-cleanup abilities

* The ability to work confidently with large amounts of data and 4K footage

* A computer capable of handling demanding editing projects

* Fast and reliable internet, including strong upload and download speeds

* The ability to produce quality work under time pressure

* Excellent organisation and file-management skills

* Strong attention to detail

* Clear English communication

* Reliability and the ability to follow instructions carefully

* The willingness to receive feedback and continuously improve



Experience editing construction, architecture or real estate content is preferred but not essential. If you have not worked in these industries before, you may still apply if you can demonstrate a relevant editing style and strong creative ability.



What We Offer



* AUD $800 per fortnight / AUD $1,600 per month

* Three weeks of paid annual leave

* A stable, full-time remote position

* An immediate start

* Ongoing support and feedback

* Opportunities to improve your editing and creative skills

* A chance to work with exciting Australian construction brands

* Interesting footage from beautiful homes and major projects

How to Apply



To be considered, your application must include all of the following:

title: Coverage Virtual Assistant
description:
Compensation: $350/month

Coverage Shift: Thursday–Monday

Hours: 1:00 PM–9:00 PM Pacific Time
