There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 28 – September 7

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance

HOW TO APPLY

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 28 – September 7

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: |

IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:

Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.

title: AI Book/Content Creator
description:
Peak Media World is looking for a reliable and organized AI Book/Content Creator to help us create books and other long-form content using structured AI-assisted workflows.



This is not a traditional writing position.



You do not need to be a professional author, editor, researcher, or AI expert. We have developed our own content production process, and you will be trained to work according to our guidelines.



What matters most to us is that you are reliable, comfortable working with AI, able to follow a structured process, and willing to learn.



What you will do



You will receive clearly defined topics and project requirements from us.



Using our workflow and AI tools, you will help turn these assignments into complete books and other long-form content.



Your tasks may include:



working with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar systems,

starting new book and content projects based on our project briefs,

using AI to develop project-specific structures, prompts, and content,

managing the production of chapters and other long-form content,

working with separate AI systems for content creation and quality review,

sending review feedback back into the production process when corrections are required,

keeping track of chapters, versions, files, and project status,

combining approved content into a complete final content package,

following our internal checklists and quality-control process,

identifying unusual or obviously incorrect results and flagging them instead of simply continuing,

preparing the completed content package for handover to our publishing operations team.



You will not be responsible for launching or publishing the finished products. Your responsibility ends with the completed and quality-checked content package.



How our AI workflow works



We do not expect you to write an entire book yourself.



We also do not expect you to create one “perfect prompt” and reuse it for every project.



Instead, you will learn our structured AI-assisted production process.



A simplified example looks like this:



Project Brief → AI Production → Independent AI Review → Revision → Quality Check → Completed Content Package



An important part of our process is that the AI producing content does not simply approve its own work. We use separate AI systems or independent AI instances for production and quality review.



Your role is to manage this process reliably according to our instructions.



What we are looking for



You may be a good fit if you:



have practical experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools,

are comfortable learning new AI tools,

can follow detailed instructions and checklists,

work reliably and in an organized way,

are comfortable managing longer projects with multiple files and versions,

can recognize when something looks unusual, incomplete, inconsistent, or obviously wrong,

are willing to stop and ask rather than blindly accepting an AI result,

have good written English,

can work independently once a process has been explained,

are interested in books, digital content, and AI-assisted content creation.



Professional book-writing experience is not required.



Formal AI qualifications are not required.



Advanced prompting expertise is not required.



We are looking for someone who can learn and reliably operate a good system—not someone who claims to know everything about AI.



What matters to us



At Peak Media World, we believe AI should make good work more efficient—not replace quality standards.



We value:



Reliability over speed.

Quality over quantity.

Following a good process over improvising.

Thinking before blindly accepting an AI result.



If something does not look right, we want you to notice it, stop, and check rather than simply move on.



Position details

Remote

Part-time

Starting rate: $4 USD/hour

Flexible working hours

Long-term opportunity

Clear workflows and instructions

Training in our internal AI-assisted book and content production process

Opportunity to take on additional responsibilities as our content production grows



We are building a long-term publishing and digital content system and are looking for someone who would like to grow with us.



How to apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. Please introduce yourself briefly.



2. Which AI tools do you currently use, and what do you normally use them for?



3. Have you ever used AI to create longer content such as an article, guide, report, e-book, book, course, or similar project?

If yes, please describe it briefly. If not, that is okay.



4. Imagine you are using AI to create content and the result looks convincing, but one fact seems questionable. What would you do?



5. Have you ever received an AI answer that you believed was incorrect or unreliable? If yes, please briefly tell us what happened and what you did.



6. How do you normally organize files and different versions when working on a larger project?



7. How many hours per week are you currently available?



Please answer the questions in your own words.



Generic cover letters are not necessary. We are much more interested in understanding how you work and think.

title: Stats person to test trading strategis
description:
Looking for a Stats Person to Test Trading Strategies (Remote, Philippines)

Pay: $200/week to start (about ₱11,300/week, roughly ₱49,000/month). This will go up substantially as the trading accounts become profitable — and how fast that happens depends a lot on you.

Hours: Full time, flexible hours, but needs real overlap with US Eastern time (New York). We can work out the exact schedule.

Setup: Work from home, long term.

 

What this actually is:



I trade futures using automated strategies (bots). Right now I do all the testing myself, and I have another business with 45 employees that takes up most of my time.  I want to hand the backtesting off to someone who is better at statistics than I am.



This is a three-person operation. Me, a guy in Manila who watches the bots during live trading (10-4 EST), and you. You'd be the one testing — running strategy variations all day, across different markets, figuring out which settings actually hold up and which ones just got lucky.



I'm not going to hover over you. I'll give you the platform, the strategy, paid AI tools, and a clear picture of what we are trying to accomplish. Then I need you to go dig. If you need someone assigning you tasks every morning, this isn't the right fit.



The work:

You'll spend your day in NinjaTrader's Strategy Analyzer running backtests. Change one setting, run the test, record what happened, compare it to the baseline, move to the next one. Over and over, across several markets.

The hard part isn't clicking buttons — it's knowing what the numbers mean. Most results look good until you poke at them. A strategy that made money over two months on one market usually falls apart the moment you test it somewhere else, or on a different period, or with realistic costs. Your job is to find the ones that don't fall apart.



Things I care about: net profit, profit factor, max drawdown, how many trades it took, and whether it stays consistent across different time periods. Win rate by itself means almost nothing to me.



I'll also give you AI (Perplexity/Claude) to work with. A big part of this job is feeding results in, talking through what they mean, arguing with it, and using that back-and-forth to d
 what to test next. You need to be able to tell when the AI is confidently wrong.  AI is an amazing tool, but it makes plenty of mistakes and needs to be guided.



Everything gets written down in proper files — what was tested, the exact settings, what the result was. I've lost a lot of work not backing up previous results before I realized the AI was compressing our convos and not saving the files I gave it.



What I need from you

• A degree in statistics, math, actuarial science, engineering, physics, economics with heavy math, or something similar. This one I'm firm on.

• You actually understand sample size, variance, expectancy, and over-fitting — not just the terms, but why they matter.

• You're a self-learner. You'll be learning futures trading, the platform, and my strategy mostly on your own. I'll answer questions, but I can't teach you line by line.

• Very careful with details. The settings screens have dozens of fields, and one wrong box means the whole day of testing was worthless.

• You can write clearly in English. I need short, honest daily updates I can read in a few minutes.

• You'll tell me when the data doesn't prove anything. I'd much rather hear "the sample is too small to say" than a hopeful guess.

• Decent computer, stable internet, quiet place to work.  I can provide a VPS if we need one, but you need a way to log into it.

You do not need any trading experience. Seriously. I'd rather have a sharp stats grad who's never placed a trade than someone with trading opinions and no math. Everything about markets can be taught.



Nice if you have it, but not required: Excel or Sheets for organizing results, some Python or R, and any experience with time-series data or experiment design.



How to apply

Skip the generic cover letter — I'll know, and I won't read it.

Send me:

1. Your degree, school, and graduation year.

3. Something quantitative you've worked on — school, thesis, or job — and what you concluded from it.

4. Whether you've used any of the AI tools, and what for.

5. Your available hours in US Eastern time.

6. Something you taught yourself, and how you went about it. Doesn't have to be technical.

title: FULL-TIME SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR — 10 ADS PER DAY, DAYTIME HOURS, LONG-TERM SEAT
description:
FULL-TIME SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR — 10 ADS PER DAY, DAYTIME HOURS, LONG-TERM SEAT

Read this entire post before applying. If you skim it, you will fail the application in the first five seconds and we will both have wasted our time. That is not a threat — it's a favor. This job is not for most people, and I'd rather you find that out now.





WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS

We run paid video ads at real scale. We need volume, every single day, forever.



Your job: produce 10 short-form video ads per day. Different products, different angles, same relentless output.



Most of these are not creative masterpieces. Be clear-eyed about what you'd be doing:



Simple product ads built from footage, images and assets we hand you.

Recreating proven ad structures. We give you a reference ad that's working in the market — you rebuild that format with OUR product, OUR footage, OUR copy. You're reproducing a structure, not copying someone's file.

Working from our swipe file. We keep a reference library of formats that convert. You'll learn it, internalize it, and pull from it fast.

High-volume iteration on winners. When an ad performs, you spin out 10 variations designed to beat it. New hook, new opening 3 seconds, new caption style, new music, new order.



Hooks, captions, pacing, sound. Fast. Clean. Consistent. Every day.



This is not a job where you get to be an artist. This is a job where you get to be the most reliable person in the company. If the word "volume" makes you tired, stop reading. If the idea of one client, one seat, work handed to you every morning, no invoice-chasing, no pitching, no ten-clients juggling act — if that sounds like relief — keep reading.





WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT, IN THIS EXACT ORDER

You show up. Every scheduled day. Not "most days." Not "I had internet problems." Every day.

You clear the day's list. Around 10 ads a day on average. Consistently.

You stay. We are building a team, not renting a freelancer for two months.

Your editing is good enough — and gets better.



Notice that skill is fourth on this list. That is not a mistake. We can teach you our formats, our hooks, our caption style, our pacing — we have a whole system for it, and the person who reads this carefully and types "surdeg" as the first word in the title when applying for this job is already showing me the exact trait I'm hiring for. It is not mentioned in the title structure, but it is supposed to be the first word, then the title structure. What we cannot teach is a person who is at their desk at the same time every day for the next two years. If you have that, and your edits are decent, you will beat a more talented editor who disappears for three days without a message.





HOURS — AND YES, THEY'RE NORMAL ONES

Monday to Saturday, 8 hours per day, on Philippine time. Roughly 09:00–18:00 PHT with a break. We'll lock your exact hours together before you start.

No graveyard shift. No night work. No waiting up until 2am for a Western client. I start my own day very early, so I'm already online and reachable through most of your workday. You get to sleep at night like a normal human being.

Occasional Sunday pushes when a launch demands it. Paid extra, never assumed, never unpaid.

You keep your regular Philippine holidays. Tell us in advance, that's all.



If you cannot commit to six days a week, every week, do not apply. That is the entire job.





PAY — READ THIS PART SLOWLY

This is a real monthly salary, not piece work. I am not going to pay you per clip and have you racing to grab the easy ones. Some ads take five minutes. Some take an hour. You get paid for clearing the day, not for counting files.



Monthly salary: $520 USD. Paid twice a month, on time, every time. We have never missed a payment and we never will.



On top of that:



$60 USD consistency bonus, every month you clear your daily list on every scheduled day with zero missed days. This is the easiest money in the job and it is entirely within your control.

$50 USD push bonus in any month where you clear meaningfully more than your assigned lists — when we ask for a surge before a launch and you actually deliver it.

$15 USD per winner. Any ad of yours that becomes a top performer in our account. Uncapped, and this is the real upside. More ads out the door means more chances at a winner, which is exactly why we don't need to pay you by the clip to make you fast.

Your first raise comes after ONE month. Not six. Not "we'll see." One month.



The raise ladder, in writing:



When

Monthly salary

With bonuses, realistically

Start

$520

~$580–630

After 1 month

$550

~$610–660

After 3 months

$580

~$640–690

After 6 months

$620

~$680–730





Every step is automatic if you're still clearing your lists. It goes into your agreement on day one. You will never have to ask me for a raise, and I will never "forget."



I put the first raise at one month on purpose. Most clients dangle a raise at six months and half of them never pay it. I'd rather prove to you inside four weeks that when you deliver, the number actually moves — and then keep proving it. Winner bonuses sit on top of every row above.



How the daily target actually works. Every morning you get a list. On a light day that might be twelve quick iterations off a winner. On a heavy day it might be six builds from raw footage. I size the list, not you — so you are never punished for drawing the hard jobs, and never rewarded for cherry-picking the easy ones. Ten a day is the average we're aiming for across a week, not a rule applied to every single day.



What counts as done: delivered on time, follows the brief, correct format and aspect ratio, captions clean, no technical errors. Not a taste judgment. If I send something back I tell you exactly why in one sentence, and it counts once you fix it.





WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

Please save us both the time. Do not apply if:



You are juggling other clients and this would be "one of them."

You need creative freedom and ownership to feel motivated.

Your internet is unreliable and you have no backup connection.

You have no plan for brownouts or power cuts.

You cannot work six days a week.

You want to negotiate the salary upward before you've proven a single month.

You are looking for a placeholder while you search for something better.

You want to "grow into a Creative Director role." That's not this seat.



I'm not being harsh for fun. I hired for this before and lost good people because they wanted a different job than the one I actually had. This time I'm describing it exactly.





HOW TO APPLY — THIS IS THE FIRST TEST

Ninety percent of applicants will get this wrong. That's the point.

1. Subject line, formatted EXACTLY like this:

| [most short-form ads you've ever finished in ONE day] | [main editing software] | [hours/day you can work] | [days/week you can work] | [your download speed from speedtest.net]



Example: XXXXXX | 8 | CapCut | 8 | 6 | 45mbps



The codeword is written somewhere in this post. I'm not telling you where. If you actually read the whole thing, you already have it.



Wrong format, missing codeword, missing a field — deleted unread. No exceptions, no second chances.

2. Your message must contain these six things, in this order, and nothing else:

Line 1 — The most finished edits you have ever delivered in a single day. Who was it for, and what were they. One or two real sentences. Generic answers are deleted.



Your setup — Computer and specs. Internet provider and speed. Backup internet. What you do when the power goes out. Be specific and boring. "I have good internet" is a failed answer.



Longevity — The longest you have ever stayed in one role or with one client. How long, and why it ended. Be honest. A short history with an honest reason beats an inflated one.



Your work — 2 to 3 links to short-form ads or edits you made. Not a reel. Pick the ones closest to simple product ads. Your judgment about what to show me is part of the test.



One honest answer — What would make you quit this job? Everyone has a breaking point. Tell me yours. I trust the person who names it far more than the person who says "nothing."



Last line — Your single most-used keyboard shortcut while editing, and what you use it for.



Do not attach a generic CV. It will not be read.





THE THREE STAGES

Stage 1 — The application above. Takes 20 minutes if you're serious. Most people won't do it.



Stage 2 — The volume test. Unpaid. If your application is sharp, I send you a folder of raw footage and one reference format. You deliver 3 finished ads within 24 hours. I am not grading beauty. I am grading: did you follow the brief exactly, did you deliver on time, and did you ask smart questions instead of guessing. This is a real preview of the daily job.



Stage 3 — Paid trial week. Full structure, real work, real feedback. This is where the seat is won.





WHAT YOU GET IF YOU WIN IT

One client. One team. Daytime hours. Same work, same people, every day. A real monthly salary paid on time, twice a month, without you ever having to ask. A raise on a schedule, not on a whim — the first one after four weeks. Direct feedback from someone who will tell you exactly what's wrong so you can fix it and get better fast.



If you're the kind of person who is tired of chasing clients and just wants a seat, a number to hit, and to be paid reliably for hitting it — this is that.



Show me you can follow instructions. That's the whole first test.

title: AI Automation Specialist | Agents, Tools & Business Workflows
description:
Part time to start, with room to grow. Must have a minimum of 3 years of experience with proof.



I’m building Practical AI Partners. We help business owners identify where AI can save time, choose the right tools, and implement practical improvements.



Our service starts with a paid AI and workflow assessment, followed by optional implementation and ongoing support.



I’m looking for someone who can become my technical right hand and help build this business from the ground up. You should be comfortable researching tools, designing workflows, building automations and AI agents, and explaining your recommendations in plain English.



What you’ll do



• Review discovery notes and identify repetitive tasks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.

• Research and test tools, including features clients already pay for.

• Recommend solutions based on cost, ease of use, reliability, and business value.

• Build automations, AI assistants, agents, and integrations.

• Help create our assessment reports, reusable templates, and delivery process.

• Test your work, troubleshoot failures, and document how everything works.

• Record walkthroughs and help clients learn to use what we build.



Experience we’re looking for



• Real examples of AI tools or automations you have implemented.

• Strong experience with at least one automation platform, such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or Power Automate.

• Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for business workflows.

• Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, and integrations between business applications.

• Good judgment about when a simple tool or process change is enough and when a custom build makes sense.

• Clear written and spoken English, strong documentation, and independent problem solving.



Experience with Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, CRMs, knowledge bases, or client onboarding workflows is a plus. You do not need to know every platform.



Your first projects



Help us create a repeatable process for turning a client discovery call into a useful assessment. Build two or three demonstration workflows, then help scope and deliver our first client implementations.



To apply, please include



Two examples of workflows or agents you personally built. Explain the problem, tools used, your role, and the result.

A short screen recording showing one working example. Use demo data or hide private information.

An example of something that failed in an automation and how you fixed it.

Your strongest tools, weekly availability, time zone, and expected hourly or monthly rate.



We’ll start with a small paid trial using a sample business workflow. If it’s a good fit, the role can grow into an ongoing technical lead position.



Please send a specific application that shows your work and how you think.

title: GHL and Meta Ads
description:
***At Polaris, we’re on the lookout for a driven, detail-oriented, and marketing-savvy Marketing and Acquisitions Assistant to join our world-class team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love the idea of being the operational backbone of a company’s marketing engine, and have strong hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, content creation, CRM systems, and social media, this role is for you.



***About us:

Polaris is a consulting agency with a bold mission: To help 1 million Founders to leverage time, reclaim freedom, and scale without sacrifice. We’re the only firm blending coaching and done-for-you services through a hybrid model — empowering our clients with strategic delegation, streamlined operations, and scalable systems.



***Role Mission

Be the driving force behind the client acquisition process of established online coaches, consultants, and info product founders. These are expert-led businesses where the founder IS the brand. Your job is to oversee Meta ad campaigns such as lead ad campaigns, low-ticket course campaigns, and appointment/VSL campaigns — making sure that ad spend is turning into leads, customers, booked calls, and sales. You own two tightly connected lanes end to end: the Meta ads that put the founder's offer in front of the right people, and the GoHighLevel infrastructure that captures, nurtures, and routes every lead toward a call. This is not a support role for someone who waits to be told what to do — we're looking for a proactive, driven, high-energy operator who is ready to stand alongside the Founder and take real responsibility over marketing performance.





***Role Responsibilities

Meta Ads - End-to-End Campaign Ownership

- Strategy: Build the paid strategy around the funnel and offer stage lead magnet opt-ins, appointment/booked-call campaigns, webinar registrations, and low-ticket product sales for coaching and consulting offers. Map each campaign to a clear objective and a target cost per result.

- Audience targeting: Research and build custom audiences (pixel, CRM lists, engagement) and lookalikes; layer interest, behavior, and demographic targeting; set exclusions to avoid overlap and waste; and build retargeting audiences from website, video, lead-form, and CRM data.

- Creative production: Research winning competitor ads in the coaching/consulting space (offers, hooks, angles, formats); format and produce scroll-stopping static and video ad creatives; write ad copy (primary text, headlines, CTAs) that positions the founder as the authority; and run a steady pipeline of creative variations to test.

- Campaign build & launch: Set up campaigns, ad sets, and ads in Meta Ads Manager - including lead ad forms, appointment campaigns, placements, and conversion events and wire tracking end-to-end with pixels, Conversion API, and GoHighLevel before a single dollar goes live.

- Budget management: Allocate and pace daily/lifetime budgets across campaigns, scale winners, cut losers early, and manage frequency, CPM, and delivery to protect efficiency as spend grows.

- Performance optimization: Monitor spend and cost per booked call daily; run structured A/B tests across creatives, audiences, and offers; flag anomalies (spend spikes, tracking discrepancies, fatigue) immediately; and act on the data with a proposed fix rather than reporting and moving on.



Creative Research & Production (Ad & Funnel Assets)

- Leverage AI to analyze competitor ads, industry trends, and the messaging angles of competitor landing pages and creatives.

- Set up Claude copywriting projects with accurate project instructions and context files from competitor analysis, copywriting guidelines, and company internal assets.

s under AI assistance.

, SMS (with A2P verification), custom fields, company details, and account snapshots accurately established.

- Build funnels such as lead magnet, webinars, VSL, and low-ticket digital product funnels — including setting up forms, integrations, and connecting automated

title: Part-Time Real Estate Cold Caller
description:
📣 HIRING: Part-Time Real Estate ISA / Cold Caller & CRM Specialist



Mitchell Properties is looking for an experienced Real Estate ISA (Inside Sales Agent) / Cold Caller to join our team in a long-term, part-time remote position.



This is NOT a temporary or project-based role. I'm looking for someone who wants to become a consistent part of our team and help grow our real estate business over time.



HOURS



Part-Time | Monday–Friday | U.S. Central Time



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Your primary responsibility will be outbound real estate prospecting and lead follow-up, including:



• Circle prospecting homeowners

• Calling expired listings

• Calling expired rental/lease listings

• Following up with existing leads

• Nurturing potential buyers and sellers

• Identifying homeowners who may be considering selling

• Scheduling qualified appointments

• Managing and updating leads in our CRM

• Adding detailed notes after conversations

• Setting follow-up dates and tasks

• Maintaining an organized database

• Following up consistently until a lead is ready to move forward

• Providing daily activity/KPI reports



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



You must be:



• Experienced with outbound cold calling or inside sales

• Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

• Confident speaking with U.S.-based homeowners

• Fluent in spoken and written English

• Clear, natural, conversational and easily understood on the phone

• Comfortable handling objections and rejection

• Friendly but confident—not robotic or overly scripted

• Persistent without being aggressive

• Organized with excellent follow-up skills

• Comfortable working inside a CRM

• Self-motivated and able to work independently

• Reliable and consistent

• Comfortable being measured by calls, conversations, follow-ups and appointments



Previous U.S. real estate cold-calling/ISA experience is strongly preferred.



Experience with expired listings, circle prospecting, seller leads, buyer leads, rental/lease leads, REDX/Vortex, or real estate CRMs is a major plus.



VOICE RECORDING REQUIRED



Because this is a phone-based position, a voice recording is REQUIRED with your application.



Please submit a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and answering:



1. Tell me briefly about your cold-calling or sales experience.



2. Tell me about any U.S. real estate calling experience you have.



Then please read the following as though you were actually calling a homeowner:



“Hi, this is [Your Name] with Mitchell Properties. I know I'm calling you out of the blue, but I'm reaching out to homeowners in the area because we're speaking with people who may be considering making a move. I was curious—have you thought about selling your home, or do you have any real estate plans in the next 6 to 12 months?”



Please speak naturally. Do not use an AI-generated voice or voice enhancement that changes how you actually sound. I need to hear the voice and communication style you would use when speaking with our clients and prospects.



Applications submitted without a voice recording will not be considered.



TO APPLY



Please
 your application to:







Include:



Resume

Voice recording

Description of your previous cold-calling experience

Description of any U.S. real estate experience

CRMs and dialing systems you've used

Your availability during U.S. Central Time

Average number of outbound calls you have handled per shift/day in previous roles, if applicable



Please use the subject line:



REAL ESTATE ISA – [YOUR NAME]



I'm looking for someone who understands that successful prospecting isn't just about making calls. It's about having real conversations, identifying opportunities, following up consistently, keeping accurate CRM records, and turning conversations into appointments.



If you're looking for a long-term position and you're confident speaking with U.S. homeowners every day, I'd like to hear from you.



Lisa Mitchell

Mitchell Properties

description:
HighLevelPros is a US marketing agency. We work with retail shops — boutiques, salons, barbershops, auto shops, specialty and gift stores — and we get them one thing: more customers through the door.



We don't sell software. We don't sell "marketing." We sell results: past customers reactivated and coming back, missed calls turned into booked appointments, slow days filled, reviews that pull in new walk-ins. The shop owner keeps running their shop. We handle the rest.



Your job is to get those owners on the phone and book them for a call with our closer.



What you'll do



100+ outbound cold calls per day to retail businesses (we provide the leads and the dialing software)

Get past the front counter to the owner or decision maker

Open with the outcome, not a pitch — talk about their slow days, their empty chairs, their customer list sitting there doing nothing

Handle brush-offs and book the appointment

Log every call outcome and notes accurately

Report daily on dials, connects, and appointments set



What you need



Verifiable experience cold calling retail businesses in the US, Canada, AU, or UK

Neutral, clear English — shop owners have to understand you the first time

Someone who can talk to a small business owner like a person, not read a script at them

Thick skin. You will get hung up on. That's the job.

Reliable internet, a quiet space, and a USB headset

Availability during US business hours



Pay

Monthly base plus commission on every client that closes from your appointments. Top performers earn well above the base. We pay on time, every time, by [payment method].



HOW TO APPLY — read carefully, applications that skip a step get deleted



Start your application with the word RETAIL so I know you read this.



Then send me:



1. Your cold calling history. For each role: what were you selling, who were you calling (industry and country), how many dials a day, and your actual numbers — connects, appointments set, show rate. Be specific. "5 years of call center experience" tells me nothing.



2. A voice recording (2–3 minutes). Record yourself doing a live cold call to a retail shop owner. Pretend I own a hair salon and I answer the phone busy and annoyed. Your goal: get me talking about my slow weekdays and empty chairs, and book me for a 15-minute call with our team about filling them. Do the whole thing — including my objections and how you handle them. Upload to Google Drive or Loom and share the link.



3. Answer this in writing: You call a boutique. The person who answers says "the owner isn't here, send us an
." What do you say next, word for word?



4. Any real call recordings from past work, if you have them and are allowed to share.



I read every application that follows the instructions. Applications without the recording will not be reviewed.

**“How do I solve this and improve the system so it does not keep happening?”**

 and Workflow Systems

** within our operations.

You will receive instructions, concepts, and creative direction from our team.



Your responsibilities include:



* Editing video creatives based on our instructions

* Finding suitable **B-roll footage** based on the brief we provide

* Combining footage, B-roll, images, voiceovers, music, captions, and other assets

* Creating strong pacing that keeps viewers engaged

* Adding captions, transitions, sound effects, and other editing elements when required

* Using AI tools when needed as part of the creative production process

* Making revisions based on feedback

* Delivering projects within the agreed deadline



Most individual video tasks should be completed **within 24 hours**.



Normally, you should expect around **2–3 revision rounds** when necessary.



## Required Skills



You should be comfortable working with:



* **CapCut**

* **Higgsfield**

* Short-form social media video editing

* B-roll research and sourcing

* Direct-response / advertising-style video editing

* Fast-paced editing workflows

* English communication



Experience editing **Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, or other performance marketing creatives is strongly preferred.**



You do not need to speak Italian. Good English is enough.



## Who We Are Looking For



We care a lot about reliability.



We want someone who:



* Already has proven video editing experience

* Has a strong portfolio with existing work

* Works fast without sacrificing quality

* Follows instructions carefully

* Pays attention to small details

* Communicates clearly

* Takes feedback well

* Can work independently once instructions are provided

* Is available consistently

* Meets deadlines

* Wants a long-term working relationship



Most importantly:



**Do not apply if you are inexperienced, do not have existing portfolio work, are lazy, frequently miss deadlines, disappear during projects, or need to be chased to get work completed.**



We work quickly, and we expect the same from the people we work with.



## Position Details



* **Part-time**

* Remote

* Paid hourly

* Long-term opportunity for the right person

* Workload will vary depending on the length and complexity of each creative



## How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A link to your **video editing portfolio**

2. Your **3 best advertising creatives** you have personally edited

3. A short **video introduction of yourself** explaining:



   * Who you are

   * Your editing experience

   * What types of ads you have worked on

   * Your current availability

4. Your expected hourly rate

5. Which editing and AI tools you currently use



**Applications without an existing portfolio will automatically be ignored.**



## Editing Test



Candidates who pass the first stage will be asked to complete an editing test based on instructions provided by our team.



This allows us to evaluate:



* Editing quality

* Ability to follow instructions

* Speed

* Attention to detail

* B-roll selection

* Communication

* Ability to implement feedback



## Important



To show us that you have read the entire job post, start your application with the word:



**SKILL**



Applications that do not start with this word may be ignored.



We are looking for someone who can become a dependable part of our creative production team — not someone looking for an occasional one-off editing project.



If you are experienced, fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and confident in your editing skills, we would like to hear from you.

title: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper | Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines
description:
Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper

Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines





Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

Engagement Type: Long-term Independent Contractor

Service Days: Monday to Friday

Reports To: Australian Client Manager

Client Contact: No direct client communication required



About the Role



We are an Australian accounting practice seeking an experienced Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support a portfolio of Australian clients.

This is a hands-on, non-client-facing role. You will work directly with an Australian Client Manager, who will manage all external client communication and provide instructions, priorities and review feedback.



You will be responsible for delivering accurate bookkeeping, payroll, BAS/IAS preparation, reconciliations, month-end work and accounting support across multiple Australian entities.

This opportunity is suitable only for candidates with substantial recent experience working within, or directly supporting, an Australian accounting firm, bookkeeping practice or public practice environment.



Key ResponsibilitiesBookkeeping and Reconciliations

· Manage end-to-end bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Complete bank, credit card, loan and merchant facility reconciliations.

· Reconcile payment platforms such as Stripe, Square, PayPal, Shopify and Wise.

· Process accounts payable and accounts receivable.

· Process supplier bills, sales invoices, credit notes, refunds and payments.

· Review aged receivables and aged payables.

· Process journals, accruals, prepayments and accounting adjustments.

· Reconcile director, shareholder, beneficiary and intercompany loan accounts.

· Maintain fixed asset registers and assist with depreciation schedules.

· Investigate unreconciled, duplicated, missing or incorrectly recorded transactions.



Account Code and GST Code Review



This is a senior-level role. You must be able to review the quality and technical accuracy of bookkeeping work.



You will be required to:



· Review and correct account codes.

· Review and correct GST tax codes.

· Identify incorrect use of GST on Income, GST on Expenses, GST-Free, Input Taxed and BAS Excluded codes.

· Review the GST treatment of overseas transactions, exports, reimbursements, disbursements, insurance payments and government grants.

· Identify personal, capital, private and non-deductible transactions.

· Review general ledger accounts for unusual balances and incorrect classifications.

· Review suspense, clearing and uncategorised transaction accounts.

· Self-review all work before submitting it to the Client Manager.

· Review work prepared by junior bookkeepers where required.



Australian Payroll



· Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payroll.

· Set up and maintain employee payroll records.

· Process ordinary hours, overtime, allowances, bonuses, deductions and reimbursements.

· Process annual leave, personal leave and termination payments.

· Prepare Single Touch Payroll reporting and year-end STP finalisation.

· Calculate and reconcile PAYG withholding.

· Calculate and reconcile employer superannuation.

· Review superannuation clearing house payments and identify rejected or unpaid amounts.

· Reconcile payroll reports, payroll journals and payroll liability accounts.

· Assist with payroll tax, workers compensation and other payroll compliance requirements.



BAS, IAS and Compliance Support



· Prepare BAS and IAS workpapers for internal review.

· Reconcile GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalment accounts.

· Review GST reporting under both cash and accrual methods.

· Reconcile BAS figures to the general ledger.

· Identify prior-period errors and transactions requiring GST adjustments.

· Assist with PAYG instalment variation calculations.

· Assist with Taxable Payments Annual Reports.

· Prepare supporting documents and schedules for the firm’s accountants and tax agents.

· Monitor internal deadlines and escalate missing information promptly.



Month-End and Year-End



· Complete monthly, quarterly and annual bookkeeping files.

· Reconcile all material balance sheet accounts.

· Review payroll, GST, superannuation and PAYG liabilities.

· Prepare accruals, prepayments and other adjusting journals.

· Review accounts payable and accounts receivable cut-off.

· Reconcile fixed assets, inventory and cost of goods sold where applicable.

· Prepare year-end workpapers and supporting schedules.

· Ensure client files are ready for financial statement and income tax return preparation.



Financial Reporting



· Prepare Profit and Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

· Prepare cash flow and management reports where required.

· Compare results with prior periods, budgets or forecasts.

· Identify unusual movements, negative balances and potential accounting errors.

· Provide clear internal explanations and supporting schedules to the Client Manager.



Tax Return Experience – Highly Regarded, but not essential



Experience preparing Australian income tax returns or tax workpapers is not essential but will be a strong advantage.



Relevant experience may include:

· Individual and sole trader tax returns.

· Company tax returns.

· Trust tax returns and distribution workpapers.

· Partnership tax returns.

· Rental property schedules.

· Depreciation and capital allowance schedules.

· Tax reconciliation workpapers.

· Xero Tax, MYOB Practice, HandiTax or BGL.



Essential Experience and Skills



Applicants must have:

· At least five years of recent Australian public practice bookkeeping experience.

· Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Advanced practical experience using Xero.

· Strong practical experience using MYOB.

· Strong practical experience using QuickBooks Online.

· Experience preparing BAS and IAS workpapers.

· Strong knowledge of Australian GST and account coding.

· Demonstrated experience reviewing and correcting GST codes.

· Strong Australian payroll, STP and superannuation experience.

· Advanced reconciliation and problem-solving skills.

· Experience preparing month-end and year-end workpapers.

· Excellent written and spoken English.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

· The ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.

· High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional conduct.

· Ability to use AI tools



Experience limited to internal bookkeeping for one Australian business may not satisfy the public practice experience requirement.



Qualifications



The following qualifications are highly regarded:

· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce.

· Diploma or recognised qualification in Accounting or Bookkeeping.

· CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent studies.

· Xero Advisor Certification.

· MYOB or QuickBooks certification.



Software



You must be confident using:



· Xero

· MYOB

· QuickBooks Online



Independent Contractor Arrangement



This is an independent contractor opportunity and not an employee position.



The contractor will:



· Provide services remotely from the Philippines.

· Provide their own computer, secure workspace, internet and backup power arrangements.

· Be responsible for their own business registration, taxation, invoicing and insurance obligations.

· Issue a valid monthly contractor invoice.



The contractor will ordinarily provide services Monday to Friday and maintain regular overlap with Australian business hours.



The parties will agree on a daily core collaboration window for meetings, questions and internal communication. Outside that window, the contractor may arrange their own working schedule, provided all deadlines and service requirements are met.



Timesheets and Work Records



The contractor must complete a daily timesheet recording:



· Date.

· Client or entity.

· Task performed.

· Time spent.

· Work completed.

· Outstanding issues and next steps.



Timesheets are used for client costing, workflow management, capacity planning and supporting the contractor’s invoice. They are not intended to operate as employee attendance records.

Remote Work Requirements



Applicants must have:



· A reliable computer or laptop.

· Stable high-speed internet.

· Backup internet.

· A quiet and secure home office.

· A suitable headset for online meetings.

· The ability to use multi-factor authentication and secure password systems.

· A strong commitment to privacy, confidentiality and data security.



How to Apply



Please submit:

· Your current resume.

· A brief cover letter of your Australian public practice experience.

· Details of your Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks Online experience.

· Details of your BAS, IAS and Australian payroll experience.

· Details of any Australian tax returns you have prepared.

· Your expected monthly contractor fee in Philippine pesos.

· Your earliest available commencement date.

· Confirmation of your internet.

· Confirmation that you can issue invoices as an independent contractor.



Pay: Php70,000.00 - Php80,000.00 per month
