title: MARKETING TEAM: DESIGN, MEDIA, SOCIAL, SEO & WEB (PART TIME / MAY EXPAND)
description:
Good Work Should Be Impossible to Miss. 



Elorae works with education programs mainly in Korea that already have strong students, strong events, strong teaching, and a lot worth showing. The problem is not a lack of material. The problem is turning that material into a consistent public presence that looks good, sounds right, reaches people, and stays current.



We are building a Marketing team rather than hiring isolated freelancers who never talk to each other. The team can include a Director plus specialists. Some candidates may cover more than one seat if the work is genuinely strong.



Current roles include:

• Marketing Director

• Graphic Designer

• A/V Editor

• SEO Specialist

• Social Media Manager

• Website Manager



What This Team Does

Graphic Design: event graphics, social posts, promotional materials, thumbnails, handouts, branded assets, and visual cleanup across active programs.



A/V Editing: short-form video, event highlights, student/performance clips, promotional edits, reels, and other media that can go from raw footage to publishable content without drama.



Social Media: planning, scheduling, posting, captions, community engagement, platform management, and turning a pile of possible content into a consistent publishing rhythm.



SEO: improving discoverability, page structure, metadata, search performance, content targeting, and finding practical opportunities rather than producing reports nobody uses.



Website Management: keeping sites clean, current, functional, and reliable. Content updates, structural improvements, SEO implementation, testing, and maintenance all matter. Vibe coding is fine if the output is tested and stable.



Marketing Director: d
 what deserves attention, coordinating the specialists, maintaining standards, reading results, and making sure design, social, web, SEO, and media actually reinforce one another.



Who This Is For

We want people who have done real work for real clients, employers, organizations, publications, channels, or projects. Your portfolio should make your case for you.



For visual and media roles, Canva can be part of your workflow but it should not be the limit of your ability. Adobe tools, Figma, professional editing software, motion graphics, or equivalent skills are advantages where relevant.



For Social Media, we care about judgment and results, not simply whether you personally use Instagram or TikTok. Show us accounts you managed, content you produced, growth you influenced, or campaigns you helped run.



For Website/SEO, we care about live work, reliability, testing, and whether you understand what happens after something is published. A broken production site is not a learning exercise.



For Marketing Director, show that you can prioritize and coordinate other people's output, not just make your own.



A Word About Your Setup

This is remote work. You need your own laptop or desktop, a stable connection of at least 30 Mbps download with acceptable latency, and a workspace suitable for focused work and video calls. We operate on Korea Standard Time and some KST overlap is required.



Hours and Payment

These are part-time roles that can expand based on performance and team need. A strong person who can genuinely cover two adjacent seats may be more valuable than two mediocre specialists.



Paid probation begins at 5,000 KRW per hour. Longer-term compensation may shift toward output-based pay depending on role and deliverables. Website reliability work may be structured differently because availability matters as much as individual outputs.



September Philippines Interviews

We will conduct full in-person interview days in Cebu on September 22 and Manila on September 24. Strong applicants who can attend one of those days should make sure their current city is clear in the application. The jobs themselves are remote.



Application Process

Complete the VA application form:


  



Choose Marketing and rank the roles that best fit you. Include your CV and portfolio/work samples. For Design, A/V, Social Media, SEO, and Web candidates, an application without evidence of actual work is unlikely to advance.



Attentiveness Test

Write "Signal" in your subject line so we know you read the full posting.



Warning

If your portfolio is mostly templates with no evidence that you made decisions yourself, do not expect it to carry the application.



If you need to be chased to post, update, test, or finish work, this team will not be a good fit.



If something breaks and your first instinct is an excuse rather than a fix, do not apply for Website Manager.

title: AI Dog Video Creator & Sourcer (Kling 3.0) — Pet/Animal Niche
description:
AI Dog Video Creator & Sourcer (Kling 3.0) — Pet/Animal Niche



Immediate Start | Long-Term Position



We are looking for an AI Video Creative who can source and generate unlimited realistic dog footage and turn it into winning Meta video ads.



This is not a traditional video editing role. The single most important skill is being able to consistently produce believable footage of dogs with mobility issues — dogs that limp or struggle to move, and dogs that walk and run freely again. If you have experience creating realistic animals (especially dogs) with AI, you are exactly who we're looking for.



Our brand is in the pet health space: we sell a hip & joint supplement that helps dogs with joint and mobility problems. Our ads live and die by emotional, believable "before and after" storytelling.



What you'll be doing — in order of importance:



1. Sourcing & generating dog footage (most important)



Source and generate unlimited realistic clips of dogs limping / struggling to move, and dogs moving freely and happily again (and the reverse, for "before/after" storytelling)

Build a reliable pipeline so we always have this footage on demand

Blend AI generation with sourced/stock footage where useful

Keep every dog and scene believable — realism is everything in this niche



2. AI video generation with Kling 3.0



Create highly realistic AI video clips using Kling 3.0 (and similar tools like Seedream, on our subscription)

Turn static product images and our own statics into motion

Maintain accurate product details (label, colors, packaging) in every generation

Write high-quality prompts to minimize wasted generations

Study winning competitor videos, understand the concept and psychology behind them, and recreate that DNA professionally for our brand (never a direct rip)

(Preferred) Assemble the finished clips into complete Meta video ads



3. Translation & localization (easiest, lowest priority)



Adapt one competitor's Dutch video ads into natural English

Translate and rebuild voice-over and subtitles

Where needed, regenerate short clips of our on-screen talent so the mouth movement matches the new English audio accurately (lip-sync via Kling 3.0)



You will receive: AI-generated static product images, product photos, winning competitor video ads, creative briefs, scripts, and brand assets.



Requirements:



Proven ability to generate realistic dogs/animals with AI (this is the #1 requirement — please show proof)

Extensive experience with Kling 3.0 (required)

Experience in the pet, animal or similar emotional/lifestyle niche (strongly preferred)

Strong prompt engineering skills

Experience creating Meta/Facebook ecommerce video ads

Good understanding of direct-response advertising

Excellent attention to detail

Fast communication

Available to start immediately



IMPORTANT — please include the following with your application:



Examples of AI-generated video you've created with Kling 3.0 — ideally involving dogs or animals.



One real sourced clip that proves you can find this footage yourself. Send us one example video you have actually found online of a dog with a mobility issue (limping / struggling to move, and/or moving well again — a "before and after" type of clip), exactly the kind of footage you would use in our ads. Tell us where and how you found it and how easily you can access it on an ongoing basis.



Hours



Approximately 20 to 40 hours per week depending on performance

Opportunity for significantly more hours based on quality and performance



This is a long-term opportunity for the right person.

We will teach you the rest, you will be mentored closely by our founder, and you will get your own AI agent to help you build, plan and get things done.



Role 1: Delivery Lead



You are the person who makes sure client builds keep moving. Right now our founder drives every build personally. That does not scale, and that is why this role exists.



You will not be thrown in the deep end. You start in a delivery admin and project management seat, working closely with our founder and learning how we do things. We do want you to pick it up quickly, because the point is that you grow into the full role.



Where you are heading:



- Own the build schedule. Know what is due, what is blocked, and on what.

- Make sure everything a build needs is ready before it starts, so nobody is waiting around on day one.

- Keep the founder's list clear. Put the things on it that genuinely need him, and handle the rest.

- Own our build pages: the documents that say what a build is and what has to happen in it.

- In time, run builds end to end yourself.



You start on an internal project, not on client work. Your first stretch is on our own systems, so you learn how the business actually works and how we deliver before you go anywhere near a client.



You are a fit if you are organised in a way other people can rely on, you write clearly, you are comfortable around technical things without needing to be a developer, and you chase things down without being asked twice.



Role 2: Junior Engineer



We are hiring this one junior on purpose, and you will not be turned loose on client builds.



You will stand up systems in our own environments, working from templates we have already proven. Moving anything into a client's system is handled by our founder. Your job is to build the thing properly in a safe space, and to get better fast.



What you'll do:



- Build and configure agent systems: automations, integrations, agent workflows.

- Connect things up. APIs, webhooks, and the tools our clients run on.

- Troubleshoot when something is not behaving, and keep it running.

- Document what you built so the next person is not guessing.



You are a fit if you have built real things, you can learn a tool you have never seen before without giving up on it, and you care whether what you shipped actually works.



About us, and how we work



Tight team, no bureaucracy, a lot of trust. We work with AI agents every day, not as a gimmick but as how the work gets done, and you will be given your own. We move fast and we care a lot about being accurate, because our clients pay real money and they can see everything we do.



You will be working closely with the founder from day one, and the plan is that you keep growing into more.



How to apply



Send us a short video. Under 10 minutes. We would rather hear five good minutes than twenty-five.



Tell us:



1. Which of the two roles you think you fit better, and why.

2. Something you have built, and show it to us if you can.

3. How you work out a tool or a problem you have never seen before.

4. Why you are applying for this.



Don't be shy, we are a friendly group and we read every one.



Applications without a video will not be considered. And please reply quickly when we get in touch, because we move fast and so should you.

title: Virtual Tax Preparer
description:
Tax Agent — Wilkins & Associates



South Carolina | Remote | 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM EST Required | Seasonal with Year-Round Growth Potential



Wilkins & Associates is a growing tax, accounting, and advisory firm serving individuals and small businesses across South Carolina and beyond. Our services include tax preparation, bookkeeping, payroll, IRS resolution, and CFO advisory. We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Tax Agent who is experienced in both individual and business tax returns to join our team for the current and upcoming tax seasons.



Compensation & Schedule

Competitive per-return or hourly pay (based on experience and production)

Bonus opportunities and long-term advancement

Required availability: 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Standard Time, Monday through Friday. This is a set schedule, not flexible hours. Applicants outside the Eastern time zone must be able to work these hours consistently.

Position Overview



The Tax Agent prepares and files accurate individual and business returns, researches tax positions before taking them, works directly with clients, and ensures full compliance with IRS regulations and firm standards. A significant portion of our client base consists of small business owners, so the ability to prepare business entity returns independently is required, not optional. Because this role involves direct verbal communication with clients, the ability to speak clear, professional English is also required. The role demands professionalism, sound judgment, and an unwavering commitment to accuracy and confidentiality.



Key Responsibilities



Business Return Preparation



Prepare and file S-corporation (1120-S), partnership (1065), and corporate (1120) returns as assigned

Prepare Schedule C, Schedule E, and Schedule F returns for sole proprietors, rental owners, and farm clients

Produce and reconcile Schedules K-1 and confirm they tie to the entity return

Track shareholder and partner basis, distributions, and capital accounts

Review reasonable compensation for S-corporation owners and flag concerns to the reviewer

Reconcile client books to the tax return and identify entries that require adjustment before filing

Handle depreciation schedules, fixed asset additions and disposals, Section 179, and bonus depreciation

Coordinate the flow between the business return and the owner's personal 1040



Individual Return Preparation & Filing



Prepare and file federal, state, and local individual returns, including multi-state filings

Build supporting schedules and workpapers (vehicle, home office, cost of goods sold, owner compensation)

Prepare extensions, estimated tax payments, and amended returns as needed

Monitor e-file acknowledgments, correct rejections, and confirm every return is accepted — not just transmitted



Tax Research (Required)



Conduct independent tax research on unclear, complex, or unusual client positions before a return is filed

Use IRS publications, the Internal Revenue Code, regulations, rulings, and professional research tools to reach a supportable conclusion

Document research findings in writing with the authority cited, and attach it to the client file

Research state and local filing requirements for entities operating in multiple jurisdictions

Stay current on tax law changes and bring anything that affects our client base to the review team



Client Work



Collect intake documents, review for completeness, and follow up on missing items

Review completed returns with clients by phone or video and explain results clearly in plain language

Identify tax exposure, risk, and savings opportunities and propose compliant solutions

Support tax planning and advisory conversations under the direction of senior staff

Assist with IRS and state notices, including transcript review and drafting responses on resolution cases



Compliance & Firm Standards



Confirm a signed engagement letter is in place for the specific service before any work begins; new or additional services require a new engagement letter

Obtain required client authorizations (including Forms 8821 and 7216 where applicable) before contacting taxing authorities or releasing information

Maintain strict compliance with IRS Circular 230, firm policy, and ethical standards

Safeguard all client data at the highest level of confidentiality

Apply for and maintain an active PTIN

Keep client records, notes, and status updates current in firm systems and CRM

Conduct client communication through the firm's client portal, not personal

Attend all required training and compliance sessions

Flag anything unclear to the reviewer before submission, not after

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated experience preparing business tax returns. Applicants must be able to independently prepare Form 1120-S and Form 1065, including K-1s, basis tracking, and depreciation schedules.

Proficiency with individual returns, including Form 1040 and Schedule C

Must be able to speak clear, professional English. This position requires live phone and video conversations with clients.

Availability to work 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM EST, Monday through Friday

Demonstrated ability to research a tax question and support the answer with authority

Strong working knowledge of current tax law and IRS regulations

Comfort reading and interpreting a client's financial statements to prepare an entity return

Strong written English for client
s, notes, and research memos

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

Professional demeanor and strong client communication skills

Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Reliable internet connection and a secure personal computer

Ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced tax environment

Preferred (Not Required)

Enrolled Agent, CPA, CTEC, or active tax credential

Experience with Form 1120 (C-corporation) and Form 1041 (trusts and estates)

Experience with professional tax software and research platforms

Experience in a virtual or fully remote tax firm

Exposure to IRS resolution, notices, or transcript analysis

Working knowledge of QuickBooks or comparable bookkeeping software

Training & Support

Full onboarding and compliance training

Ongoing education, mentorship, and research support

Review and guidance from experienced senior tax staff

Growth Opportunity



High-performing Tax Agents may qualify for:



Year-round employment

Advisory and review roles

Leadership and management opportunities

Long-term career growth within Wilkins & Associates



To apply: submit your resume, credential information, and a summary of your business return experience — entity types, approximate volume per season, and the software you've used — to
.

title: $2k, $3k, $4k... doesn't matter. Good video editor? Name your price.
description:
$2k, $3k, $4k... doesn't matter. If you're good, name your price.



We're looking for a hungry, senior-level video editor to build the next wave of ads for our pet supplement brand. VSLs, AI-animation ads and AI UGC. You'll work directly with us.



-> The product



* Dog supplements.

* 7-figure brand, under a year old, on track for 8 figures this year

* Retention among the best in the industry. People actually reorder, so we can spend hard on the front end. When your ad wins, it gets real budget behind it (bigger bonuses for you...)



-> Current bottleneck



We have more winning angles and scripts than editing capacity. We need more volume AND more quality: finished 3-minute VSLs that stop the scroll, fewer revision rounds, and faster feedback loops from brief to live ad.



-> Why us



* Base: $2,000+ per month.

* $300 every time you hit a breakthrough.

* 5% of the ad spend on every ad you make fully yourself (our internal bounty program).

* $1,000 bonus for top editor of the month.

* Education on us: Evolve, RMBC 2, Zakaria's course, and anything else you ask for.

* As many 1:1s with the founder as you want.

* A real path: editor to creative strategist to CMO. Nothing stops you except your own will.



-> Don't apply if



* You're not ok with blunt feedback.

* You work at a slow pace. A 3-minute VSL is a one-day job for you, not a one-week project.

* You just go through the motions. We want thinkers.

* You want part-time, you're an agency, or you'd keep another job on the side. Full-time only, and you quit your current job cleanly.

* No experience with AI UGC/AI ANIMATIONS/AI SONGS (Fal.ai / Suno.ai / etc....)



-> What We're looking for



Editors who can THINK. Take what the script says and bring it to life. Animation, transitions, sound design, a cross-section, whatever makes the idea land.



Closing feedback loops is the most important thing in creative strategy. When we hand you an idea, we need speed AND quality.



We want editors who make our ideas better with AI. Especially hooks: we want the PERFECT clip to stop the scroll, and if we don't have it, you generate it. You should already live inside Veo, Seedance, Kling, HeyGen, Arcads and ElevenLabs.



We want clear communication. Ask us if something is unclear. Tell us if you're delayed. Bounce ideas off us, it shows you're thinking. And if you think we're wrong about an ad, say so and prove it. We love that.



-> Requirements



* You've edited for 7, 8 or 9-figure DTC brands, ideally health, supplements or pet, and you can prove it.

* You're a killer at VSLs, AI-animation ads and AI UGC.

* You're an AI geek.

* Your English is fluent enough to debate ideas with us. Accent doesn't matter. Articulating your thinking does.



-> How to apply



Put your price in the first line of your application. Then send 3 things. If one is missing, we won't review it.



1. A personalized 1-minute Loom: you, your experience, the brands you've worked with, and what you genuinely crush.

2. A link to YOUR portfolio. If we find ads in it that aren't yours, you're out.

3. Your best ad with the numbers behind it (spend, ROAS or CPA, how long it ran), plus one paragraph on why your price is justified.



-> How hiring works



1. A 15-minute call.

2. A paid test brief: a real VSL from our queue.

3. Onboarding. We move fast for the right person.



TLDR: We want talent, but hungry talent. If you can deliver what we're looking for, we'll make a lot of money together.

title: Finance Assistant (with Accounting Experience)
description:
About the role



We're looking for a Finance Assistant with solid accounting fundamentals to keep our day-to-day finance function running smoothly. You'll own the bookkeeping cycle, support month-end close, and help keep us compliant with UAE VAT and corporate tax requirements.



This is a fully remote role on a fixed six-hour daily schedule aligned to UAE business hours. We care about accuracy, follow-through, and clear communication, not hours logged.



What you'll do and assist with:

Maintain accurate books: journal entries, general ledger, and accruals

Process accounts payable and receivable, including invoicing, payment runs, and collections follow-up

Perform bank, supplier, and intercompany reconciliations

Support month-end and year-end close, including schedules and supporting documentation

Prepare and file UAE VAT returns through the FTA portal, and maintain the underlying records

Assist with UAE corporate tax compliance — data preparation, workings, and filing support

Track expenses, employee reimbursements, and petty cash

Prepare recurring management reports and assist with budget tracking and cash flow forecasting

Liaise with external auditors and tax advisors during reviews and filings

Keep financial records organised and audit-ready in line with UAE record-keeping requirements



What you'll need

2–5 years of hands-on accounting or finance experience, ideally but not limited to UAE-based work

Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field

Working knowledge of UAE VAT — registration thresholds, return preparation, input/output VAT treatment, and FTA portal filing

Familiarity with UAE Corporate Tax rules and compliance obligations

Understanding of IFRS and standard double-entry bookkeeping

Confident with accounting software (QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho Books) 

High attention to detail and comfort handling confidential financial information

Strong written and spoken English

A reliable remote setup and the discipline to work independently within set hours



Nice to have

Part-qualified or pursuing ACCA, CPA, CMA, or CA

Experience in a consulting or professional services environment

Exposure to ESR, AML, or UBO reporting requirements

Experience supporting multiple entities or clients



Why join us

Fully remote, with a predictable 10–4 schedule that leaves your mornings and evenings free

Direct ownership of the finance function rather than a narrow slice of it

Exposure to UAE tax and regulatory work across a varied client base

A small, senior team where your work is visible and your input counts

title: Video Podcast Editor (Part Time, 15 to 20 Hours Per Week)
description:
I am looking for a video podcast editor who can take multi-camera interview footage and turn it into episodes people watch all the way through. This is a part-time role, roughly 15 to 20 hours per week, with steady weekly work for the right person.



This job is about pacing and polish. Two people talking for an hour only holds attention if the editor knows when to cut, when to breathe, and when to drop in something visual. That is the skill I am hiring for.



Here is what you need to be able to do.



- Cut multiple camera shots together, with quick cuts between speakers so the conversation feels alive

- Clean up audio, balance levels, and remove background noise so every voice sounds clear

- Add lower thirds, intros, outros, and graphic overlays

- Pull sound and moments from outtakes and layer them in where they add energy

- Add B-roll, graphics, and royalty free background music that fits the tone

- Find your own B-roll for custom projects in a technical industry, sourcing footage from the companies we interview or from public projects on YouTube



That last point matters more than you might think. Our episodes cover a technical field, and I will not always hand you a folder of clips. I need someone who can research the guest, find relevant footage of their facilities and projects, and work it into the edit without being asked. Attention to detail is everything in this role, so when you apply, put the word "cucumber" in your
 subject line.



The main deliverable is full podcast episodes, whatever gets thrown at you. On top of that, you will create clips and shorts from each episode for social. If you have experience uploading and publishing to YouTube, Apple Podcasts, or Spotify, tell me, because that is a big plus and part of where I want this role to go.



Here is how the hiring process works. First, there is a free test task. I will send you two shots with audio, and your job is to cut them together into one engaging scene of about 10 minutes. If that goes well, I will give you a longer paid test task, which will be a full podcast episode. If you pass both, the job is yours on a part-time, weekly basis.



I pay twice a month via Wise, on the 1st and 16th. The payment on the 16th covers work from the 1st to the 15th, and the payment on the 1st covers the 16th through the end of the month.



To apply,
 me directly at 
 not use the OnlineJobs.ph messaging system, I do not check those messages. Include links to podcast episodes you have edited, and any shorts or clips that performed well.



Looking forward to finding an editor who makes every episode better than the raw footage deserves.

title: Payroll Administrator – U.S. Payroll
description:
Wilkins & Associates | Spartanburg, South Carolina, USA

Hours: Monday–Thursday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (16 hours/week)



About the role

Wilkins & Associates is a U.S. tax, accounting, and CFO advisory firm serving small business owners in the United States. We run payroll for a growing list of clients and need an experienced payroll professional to own that work start to finish — processing payroll, filing and paying U.S. payroll taxes, and working tax notices from the IRS and South Carolina agencies until they're resolved.



This is a remote contractor position open to candidates outside the U.S. You must already have real, hands-on experience with U.S. payroll. This is not a training role — we're looking for someone who can step in and handle the work from day one.



What you'll do



Process weekly and bi-weekly payroll for multiple U.S. clients, on time every cycle

Set up new clients and employees, including federal and state withholding and unemployment accounts

Register and manage client accounts with SC DEW through the SUITS portal — new registrations, quarterly wage reports, rate notices, and corrections

Onboard clients moving to us from ADP, Paychex, or other providers and make sure prior wages and taxes carry over correctly

File and reconcile U.S. payroll tax returns — 941, 940, W-2/W-3, state withholding, and state unemployment

Handle payroll tax letters from the IRS, SCDOR, and SC DEW: log the notice, call the agency, gather what's needed, prepare the response, and follow it through to closure

Track penalty and interest exposure and prepare abatement requests where appropriate

Reconcile payroll liabilities to the books and flag anything that doesn't tie

Keep client notes, deadlines, and notice status current in Canopy and our task tracker

Communicate directly with U.S. clients by phone,
, and Teams about payroll questions and deadlines



Must have



3+ years of hands-on U.S. payroll experience, ideally supporting multiple clients at an accounting firm, BPO, or payroll service bureau

Proven experience processing weekly and bi-weekly U.S. payroll cycles

Direct experience with South Carolina DEW and the SUITS system — registrations, quarterly filings, and notice responses

Experience resolving U.S. payroll tax notices yourself — calling the IRS and state agencies, correcting filings, and closing the issue, not just forwarding the letter

Solid knowledge of U.S. federal and state payroll tax rules, deposit schedules, and year-end reporting

Fluent spoken and written English — you will be on the phone with American clients and U.S. government agencies and must be clearly understood

Guaranteed availability every Monday–Thursday, 9 AM–1 PM U.S. Eastern Time. Please check what this is in your local time before applying. This schedule is fixed because it's when clients and agencies can be reached.

Gusto experience strongly preferred; ADP or similar a plus

Comfortable in QuickBooks Online and Microsoft Teams

Organized enough to manage deadlines for a dozen-plus clients without missing any



Nice to have



Experience with SCDOR MyDORWAY for withholding accounts

Prior IRS resolution or tax-notice work beyond payroll

FPC or CPP certification



Work setup



Independent contractor, 10-16 hours/week, fully remote

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a computer with a headset for calls are required

Time tracked through Hubstaff, with a short daily check-in at the end of each shift

Paid in USD, rate based on experience

Reports to the Accounting Manager

title: Creative Strategist — DTC Pet Brand (Meta Ads)
description:
Creative Strategist — DTC Pet Brand (Meta Ads)



Immediate Start | Long-Term Position



We're a fast-growing ecommerce brand in the pet health space — we sell a hip & joint supplement that helps dogs with mobility and joint issues. We're looking for a Creative Strategist who lives and breathes direct-response advertising and knows how to turn competitor research and market insight into winning Meta ad concepts.



This is not a video editing or design role. You won't be cutting the videos or designing the statics yourself. You're the brain behind what gets made and why — the bridge between research, our creators, and results.



What you'll be doing:



Research & competitor intelligence



Study competitor ads daily (Meta Ad Library, TikTok, viral content) and identify winning hooks, angles and formats

Understand why an ad works — the emotion, the audience, the psychology behind it — not just that it's running

Track what's scaling in our niche and spot trends early



Concepting & strategy



Turn that research into fresh ad concepts and angles mapped to our brand and to each stage of customer awareness (unaware → problem → solution → product → offer)

D
 the message, audience and emotional trigger for each concept

Keep a constant pipeline of new ideas to test



Briefing



Write clear, detailed creative briefs and scripts for our video editors and designers — hook, script, visual direction, format, and the "why" behind it

Make briefs so clear that creators can execute without guesswork



Analysis & iteration



Review creative performance, understand which ads win and why, and feed that back into the next round of concepts

Work in a loop: test, learn, refine — continuously improving hook rate, CTR and conversion



Requirements:



Proven experience as a creative strategist or in a similar role for DTC/ecommerce brands

Strong understanding of direct-response advertising and Meta/Facebook ads

Sharp eye for hooks, angles and ad psychology

Experience with competitor research and ad-library analysis

Ability to write clear briefs and scripts

Comfortable reading basic ad metrics (hook rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and drawing conclusions

Excellent written English and fast communication

(Preferred) Experience in pet, health, or emotional/lifestyle niches



IMPORTANT — please include with your application:



A short breakdown of one winning ad you admire — tell us why it works (the hook, the angle, the psychology).

One example of a creative concept or brief you've made (or, if new, a concept you'd pitch for a dog joint supplement).

Any results you've helped drive (ROAS, CTR, scaling) if you have them.



Applications without this will not be reviewed.



Hours



Approximately 20 to 40 hours per week depending on performance

Opportunity for significantly more hours and long-term growth based on quality



To confirm you've read the entire job post, please start your application title with the word "Hond". Applications without "Woef" in the title will not be reviewed.
